jobs.title: Product Manager - UX/UI Focus (AI x Greentech) (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
As a Product Manager at Reonic, you’ll own product problems from discovery through execution.

You’ll work closely with customers, product, design, and engineering to understand what users need, define the right solutions, and bring them to life. A strong focus of your role will be shaping the UX and UI of our product — from improving existing workflows to designing entirely new experiences.

You’ll combine product thinking with a strong eye for design, constantly asking: What problem are we solving, for whom, and how can we make the experience as simple and valuable as possible?

You’ll have significant ownership and the opportunity to directly shape how the product looks, feels, and works.

Please note: This is a fully onsite role in Augsburg.


What you'll do

  • Own product problems end-to-end: Take ownership of product areas from discovery and problem definition through prioritization, design, development, launch, and iteration.

  • Shape the user experience: Design intuitive, efficient, and delightful experiences across the product. Turn complex workflows into simple solutions that users can understand and adopt quickly.

  • Understand our users: Talk to customers, analyze feedback and usage data, identify pain points, and develop a deep understanding of how renewable installers work.

  • Think beyond the brief: Challenge assumptions, identify opportunities, and make sure we’re solving the right problem rather than simply building what was initially requested.

  • Design and prototype: Work hands-on with wireframes, prototypes, and UI concepts to explore solutions quickly. Iterate with users and the team before investing heavily in development.

  • Set the UX/UI bar: Maintain a high standard for usability, consistency, accessibility, and visual quality across the product.

  • Balance user and business needs: Make thoughtful product trade-offs based on customer value, business impact, technical feasibility, and available data.

  • Work closely with engineering: Collaborate with engineers throughout the product development process, communicate requirements clearly, and make pragmatic decisions when trade-offs arise.

  • Iterate after launch: Treat shipping as the beginning, not the end. Measure outcomes, collect feedback, identify opportunities, and continuously improve the product experience.

  • Leverage AI in your workflow: Use AI tools to accelerate research, ideation, prototyping, analysis, and product development.


What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Product experience: 2+ years of experience in product management, product design, UX/UI, or a similar product-focused role, ideally in a startup or fast-growing product environment.

  • Strong product sense: You naturally think about customer problems, business impact, and outcomes rather than simply features and output.

  • UX/UI expertise: You have a strong understanding of interaction design, information architecture, visual design, and usability. You care deeply about how a product feels to use.

  • Hands-on approach: You’re comfortable getting into Figma, creating wireframes and prototypes, testing ideas, and iterating on designs yourself.

  • Customer obsession: You enjoy talking to users and can translate qualitative feedback and observed behavior into clear product opportunities.

  • Comfort with ambiguity: You can take an unclear problem, structure it, identify what matters, and move towards a solution without needing every detail defined upfront.

  • Strong communication: You can clearly explain product decisions, design rationale, and trade-offs to engineers, designers, leadership, and other stakeholders.

  • Ownership: You take responsibility for outcomes, make decisions, and follow problems through from initial idea to measurable impact.

  • Technical curiosity: You enjoy working closely with engineers and are interested in understanding the technical constraints and possibilities behind the products you build.

  • AI-native mindset: You’re curious about how AI can improve both the products we build and the way we build them.

 

Why Join Us?

  • Real impact: Help build software that enables businesses to accelerate the transition to renewable energy.

  • A product people use: Our platform is already used by 3,000+ paying B2B customers, giving you the opportunity to work on a product with real users and real-world impact.

  • High ownership: We’re a growing company, and nothing is set in stone. You’ll have plenty of room to shape how we work and how the product evolves.

  • Fast-moving environment: Work closely with engineering and other teams, make decisions quickly, and see your work reach customers.

  • A great international team: We work hard, learn from each other, and make sure we have fun along the way.

  • Great setup: MacBook, gym membership subsidy, regular team events, coffee, Deutschland ticket and other perks.

  • Competitive compensation: We offer competitive pay based on your experience and responsibilities.


Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply! Imposter syndrome shouldn't hold you back— we value talent and passion above all.

About Reonic

At Reonic, we’re on a mission to simplify renewable technology.

Our AI operating system helps renewable energy installers run and grow their businesses — from planning and selling solar, battery storage, and heat pump solutions to managing their day-to-day operations.

Today, more than 3,000 businesses use Reonic, and we’re growing fast.


Location
This is a full-time, on-site position based in Augsburg.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Safety & Compliance
jobs.description:
CreatorIQ is the operating system for creator-led growth trusted by more than 1,300 global brands and agencies.

We’re on a mission to make businesses more human, and humans more impactful. We operate by our values — be intentional, pursue excellence every day, embrace the journey together, and be a good human — every day. CreatorIQ has earned the title of best companies to work for in multiple programs, including BuiltIn LA and NY. It’s been named a Fastest-Growing Company in North America on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ for four years, was named a leader in IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Influencer Marketing Platforms for Large Enterprises in 2025, was named a Leader by The Forrester New Wave™: Influencer Marketing Solutions, and has been consistently recognized by G2 as a Leader, and is rated 5 stars on Influencer MarketingHub. We operate in a flexible work model that combines both in-person and remote work to boost collaboration, enhance innovation, and adapt to individual work styles.

We're seeking passionate, innovative minds to join our journey. Be a part of our dynamic team and let's transform the industry together!

Product Manager, Safety & Compliance

CreatorIQ is the software enterprise brands and agencies use to run their creator marketing programs. Customers include Burson, Delta Air Lines, Google, LVMH, Nestlé and Sephora. Those programs only hold up if the content is brand safe, sponsorships are disclosed, the music is cleared, and every campaign follows the rules in the markets it runs in. You'll own the product that makes that happen.

The core is SafeIQ, our always-on brand safety system. It runs multimodal AI classification on audio, video, images and text across millions of creator posts, and flags risk before it becomes a headline.

If you like turning messy classification and regulatory problems into workflows that risk, legal and compliance teams trust, you'll fit in. We're growing fast, and we work with teams around the world who care about doing great work.

In this role, you’ll get to:

  • Own the in-app brand safety review and workflow experience end to end, with one goal: shorten the path from "AI flagged something" to "a human made a confident decision." Ship, measure, learn, repeat.

  • Decide how AI classification reaches people: severity, categories, thresholds, review states and false-positive handling. Work with data science on what the models look for across audio, video, images and text, how confident they need to be before surfacing something, and where a human stays in the loop. Make every flag explainable and auditable.

  • Own compliance beyond content risk: sponsorship and ad disclosure under FTC guidelines and their equivalents, music licensing and rights clearance, legal drinking age (LDA) rules for alcohol promotion, and GDPR and regional privacy requirements. Work with Legal, Trust & Safety and regional compliance stakeholders to stay ahead of regulatory change without making every workflow wait on a legal review.

  • Understand the business nuance for API contracts, webhook payloads and data models with engineering so customers can pull safety and compliance signals into their own systems.

  • Work with GTM on positioning, packaging and enablement so what we sell matches what the product does and what regulators require.


Who you are and what you’ll need for this position:

  • You've spent 4+ years in product management or equivalent technical product ownership in B2B SaaS. Titles matter less than the work.

  • You have good product taste. You can look at an AI-generated feature or output and tell good UX from an AI slop, and you can say why.

  • You think critically and independently. You don't take a model's output, a legal requirement, a stakeholder request or a roadmap item at face value.

  • You can turn a dense, ambiguous regulatory or licensing requirement into a workflow engineers can build, and write it up clearly without needing a meeting.

  • You know the basics of AI classification pipelines: inference, confidence thresholds, false positives and negatives, and human review. You don't have to build them.

  • You're comfortable with API contracts, webhooks and role-based access well enough to write requirements with engineers.

  • You care more about solving real user problems, like getting a risk team to zero backlog with confidence, than about shipping features for their own sake.

  • You're curious, self-driven and low-ego. You own the product end to end, don't wait to be told what's next, and are allergic to "that's not my job."

  • You're comfortable working with distributed teams. Most work is async and flexible, but occasionally we'll ask for a later call. Stakeholders for this role are distributed across NA, EU, and APAC timezones

Nice to have

  • Experience with trust and safety, content moderation, risk scoring or compliance tooling.

  • Experience with multimodal AI, content classification or ML evaluation workflows.

  • Experience with regulated content and privacy rules: FTC disclosure guidelines, music and content licensing, alcohol promotion, or GDPR and CCPA, and how they shape product requirements.

  • Experience shipping customer-facing APIs, webhooks or enterprise integrations.

  • Familiarity with social media platforms, martech or influencer workflows.

Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But we'll let you in on a secret: there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. Have 50% of the criteria? Excited about this opportunity? Passionate about what we do at CreatorIQ? Please apply! CreatorIQ is a place where everyone can grow.

What you will get from us:

  • People: Work with talented, collaborative, and friendly people who love what they do.

  • Guidance: Utilize our learning platform to fully get the training and tools you'll need to become successful here from your first day with us.

  • Work/life harmony: 25 days of vacation, floating and company holidays, wellness benefits, and paid parental leave.

  • Whole Health Package: Comprehensive healthcare coverage, including medical, dental, vision, mental health support, life insurance, income protection, and other wellness benefits.

  • Planning for the future: A Royal London Pension Plan to help you plan ahead.

  • Equity: Stock options as part of our equity-sharing program.

  • Work from home stipend: To assist you in setting up a home office that works for you.

 

Who we are:

CreatorIQ is the operating system for creator-led growth, helping global brands and agencies transform creator marketing into an intelligence-driven growth engine. Powered by the Creator Graph™, which processes more than 250 million social posts daily across more than 15 million creators worldwide, CreatorIQ unifies fragmented platform data into a centralized intelligence layer and system of record for creator relationships, performance, governance, and commerce. More than 1,300 organizations—including Dentsu, Delta Air Lines, Google, Beiersdorf, Nestlé, and Wella—rely on CreatorIQ as the infrastructure to run and scale their creator programs globally. CreatorIQ is a global company headquartered in Los Angeles with offices in Austin, New York, San Francisco, London, Manila, and Warsaw. Learn more at www.creatoriq.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

 

At CreatorIQ, we believe that diversity is the key to unlocking our full potential. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and empowering work environment where everyone can thrive, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes us unique. By embracing our core values of being intentional, pursuing excellence every day, embracing the journey together, being a good human, and staying focused on what’s important, we create an atmosphere that promotes collaboration and growth. Join us to celebrate differences, innovate together, and be a part of a business that is disrupting the marketing industry.

 

Compensation, Benefits and Beyond:

We understand that a comprehensive benefits package plays a significant role in your overall compensation. To gain more insight into the various components of our total compensation, we invite you to review our benefits and perks.

AI Transparency Notice

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications and note taking during interviews. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please refer to our Global Candidate Privacy Notice.

jobs.description:
Your journey

ROMEO is the queer company behind the legendary ROMEO dating app, one of Europe’s longest-standing dating platforms for queer communities. We are looking for a Product Owner to join our Product team in Berlin and help shape how ideas and product requirements make their way into the hands of millions of users.

In this delivery-focused role, you will work closely with Product Management, Design, Engineering, QA and BI to turn product priorities into clear, actionable work for our development teams. It is a great opportunity to grow your product skills while taking real ownership of the day-to-day delivery process.


Your typical day

  • Support the Product Management team in refining product requirements and translating approved PRDs into implementation-ready epics, user stories and tickets.
  • Ensure user stories have clear acceptance criteria and are sufficiently refined before entering development.
  • Maintain and order the backlog according to priorities set by product leadership.
  • Take part in regular and ad hoc meetings to clarify product requirements with development, design and other delivery teams.
  • Support our two-week delivery cycle by ensuring development teams have the information and decisions they need to proceed.
  • Identify missing requirements, dependencies, open decisions and blockers early, and escalate them to Product or Delivery.
  • Work closely with QA to communicate product and release priorities, clarify acceptance criteria, and support defect triage and release-readiness decisions.
  • Support product acceptance and release readiness by checking delivered functionality against agreed requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Support the BI team by translating product questions, KPIs and tracking needs into clear data requirements.
  • Ensure agreed analytics requirements are captured as part of delivery, including relevant event tracking before work is considered complete.
  • Maintain clear and up-to-date product documentation in Jira and Confluence.


We look for

  • You are passionate about building products for LGBTQ+ communities and interested in contributing to the continued development of ROMEO.
  • You have initial experience in a Product Owner or similar product delivery role, ideally in a B2C environment. Experience in social, dating or community products is a plus. Being familiar with how our product works is a plus.
  • You have experience writing or refining user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • You have a good understanding of Agile product development and ideally hands-on experience with Scrum and/or Kanban.
  • You are comfortable working with Jira and Confluence. Experience with Xray is a plus.
  • You are organised, detail-oriented and reliable in following work through to completion.
  • You proactively follow up on missing information and drive requirements towards clarity.
  • You are based in Berlin or willing to relocate and are happy to work from our Wittenbergplatz office at least three days per week.
  • You have excellent written and spoken English skills, ideally at a native or near-native level.


What We Offer

  • A hands-on role working on an established European digital product during a significant phase of product and technology transformation.
  • Close collaboration with Product, Design, Engineering, QA and BI,
  • Hybrid working (3 days per week in our Berlin office at Wittenbergplatz)
  • €40 employer contribution towards the Germany Job Ticket
  • EGYM Wellpass (only €20/month employee contribution)
  • In-house German classes

jobs.description:
Your mission

As our Product Manager – Android Integration & Ecosystem, you will define the product what and why for how ProGlove devices connect, integrate and create value within the enterprise Android ecosystem.

ProGlove is evolving from a wearable scanner company into a Worker Companion company, bringing together ergonomic wearable hardware, software, connectivity, workflow guidance, data and intelligence. With the MAI Wearable Companion, we are entering a broader ecosystem of enterprise applications, technologies, standards, partners and customer infrastructure.

Your mission will be to make our products easy to adopt, integrate and deploy at scale – without turning every customer opportunity into a bespoke engineering project. You will identify recurring customer needs, translate them into scalable capabilities and propositions, and decide where ProGlove should own, enable or partner. In doing so, you will help turn integration from a technical necessity into a source of differentiation, customer value and commercial opportunity.

You will work closely with the Product Manager responsible for the Wearable Companion device. While they own the device proposition, you will own how the device connects to and creates value in the wider ecosystem. Together, you will shape a coherent end-to-end proposition for customers, developers, integrators and partners.

Your day-to-day 
  • Define and evolve the product strategy and priorities for ProGlove’s enterprise Android integration and ecosystem capabilities, aligned with customer needs and business goals.
  • Work directly with customers, Sales and Solution Architecture to identify recurring problems, distinguish individual requests from broader market needs and turn the right opportunities into scalable solutions.
  • Translate recurring integration needs into repeatable product capabilities such as APIs, SDKs, tools, interfaces, documentation, integration patterns and deployment solutions.
  • Shape the product experience around device setup, provisioning, application distribution, device management and other capabilities required to deploy and operate connected device fleets at scale.
  • Make clear, pragmatic decisions about where ProGlove should own, enable or partner, balancing customer value, strategic control, speed, scalability and technical complexity.
  • Identify the platforms, applications, standards and ecosystem players that matter to our customers, and shape the integrations, certifications and technology partnerships that strengthen our proposition.
  • Explore where integration capabilities, software, services and ecosystem propositions can create differentiated value and support commercial or recurring-revenue opportunities.
  • Partner closely with Engineering and the Product Manager for the Wearable Companion to create alignment on customer problems, priorities, trade-offs and desired outcomes.
  • Enable Sales and other customer-facing teams to clearly explain our Android proposition, supported capabilities, integrations and common deployment patterns.
  • Maintain a forward-looking view of enterprise Android, AOSP, enterprise mobility, AI and adjacent technologies, and translate relevant developments into strategic options and product priorities.


Your profile

At ProGlove, technical expertise matters, but how you work is just as important. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, stays curious, collaborates openly and turns complexity into clear, pragmatic decisions.

  • You bring strong Product Management experience in B2B or enterprise technology and can define strategy, discover meaningful customer problems, prioritize opportunities and turn them into scalable products or propositions.
  • You are commercially minded and naturally connect product decisions with customer value, differentiation, business impact and opportunities to capture value.
  • You are comfortable working with enterprise software, platforms, connected devices, integrations or technology ecosystems, and understand the realities of complex customer IT environments.
  • You have enough technical depth to understand architecture, interfaces and trade-offs, contribute credibly to platform and integration discussions, and recognize when deeper engineering expertise is needed.
  • You think in systems and patterns: when faced with a customer requirement, you look beyond the immediate request to understand why it exists, how broadly it applies and what a simple, repeatable solution could look like.
  • You take end-to-end ownership, move topics forward without waiting for perfect instructions and remain effective when the product space or path ahead is not yet fully defined.
  • You collaborate generously and build trust across Product, Engineering, Sales, Solution Architecture, customers and external partners. You can create alignment and drive decisions without relying on formal authority.
  • You communicate clearly and transparently, raise risks early and can make complex technical and commercial topics understandable to different audiences.
  • You are curious about customers, the business and emerging technologies, and continuously test assumptions rather than pursuing technology for its own sake.
  • You use pragmatic judgment to balance speed, simplicity, quality and long-term value.
  • You are fluent in English and comfortable working in an international environment.

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be valuable, but is not required:

  • Enterprise Android, AOSP or adjacent Android ecosystems, including environments operating outside standard Google Mobile Services.
  • Enterprise mobility management, MDM/EMM, device provisioning, application deployment or connected fleet management.
  • Rugged or industrial devices, IoT or edge devices, connected hardware or other B2B technology ecosystems.
  • APIs, SDKs, developer or integrator experiences and enterprise integrations.
  • Platform or ecosystem strategy, technology partnerships, certification programs or developer and partner ecosystems.
  • Enterprise customers deploying technology at scale.
Direct Android Product Management experience is an advantage, but not essential if you bring strong Product Management expertise and relevant experience from an adjacent enterprise technology ecosystem.


Why us?

This is an opportunity to shape an important part of a category that is still being defined. 
Android gives ProGlove access to a much broader technology ecosystem, but the opportunity goes far beyond compatibility. jobs.description:
Who we are

Yubo is the Social Discovery app to make new friends and hang out online. By eliminating likes and follows, we empower our users to create genuine connections and show up as their true selves.

We've pioneered a new way for Gen Z to socialize online, and with millions of active users, our goal is to redefine how we connect today and tomorrow.

Our team is international, multicultural and deeply committed to its mission. As the leading platform to socialize online, we have a special responsibility to build a safe digital space for our community. Safety is embedded in our DNA, and our proactive approach focuses on user protection, support, and education.

Join us in this exciting journey and help us shape the future of social interactions!

About this role


At Yubo, Product Managers have real ownership. They work in strong partnership with Product Designers and Engineering, shaping strategy and decisions from problem definition all the way to delivery, with direct and visible impact on both the product and the business.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to form that partnership with a Product Designer: a duo jointly responsible for the end-to-end experiences you ship together. You'll take ownership of a strategic product area, identify the biggest opportunities, and turn them into clear product bets on a product used by millions of people.

We're moving away from small, isolated feature launches toward bigger, end-to-end experiences tested at scale. You'll combine user understanding, data and strong product convictions to frame problems, shape solutions with Design and Engineering, and decide what to scale, iterate, or stop.

You'll also work closely with Data, Machine Learning, Brand Marketing and Trust & Safety on challenges ranging from recommendation and discovery to retention, safety, monetization and AI.

This role is particularly well suited to someone who enjoys balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and who wants their decisions to have a visible impact on both user experience and business outcomes.

To make this dream duo work, we’re basing this role in Paris and looking for someone willing to come to the office once or twice a week.


Your responsibilities

  • Own a strategic product area from problem definition through delivery and post-launch iteration

  • Define product strategy and translate company objectives into clear priorities and measurable outcomes

  • Partner closely with Product Design and Engineering to shape end-to-end experiences rather than isolated features

  • Use data, research, user feedback, market insights, and product intuition to identify the problems worth solving

  • Turn opportunities into bold product bets, measure their impact, and decide whether to scale, iterate, or stop

  • Collaborate with Data, Machine Learning, Brand Marketing, Trust & Safety, and Legal to make informed product decisions

  • Balance user value, business impact, safety, and technical constraints when making trade-offs

  • Create alignment across stakeholders through clear problem framing, strong product conviction, and structured decision-making

Tools we use

  • Amplitude, SQL, Looker

  • Figma

  • Notion

  • Slack

  • Enterpret

  • AI tooling: Claude Code, ChatGPT Codex, Dust

Who you are

  • You have 4+ years of experience as a Product Manager, ideally within consumer mobile products and a startup or scale-up environment

  • You are comfortable owning a product area from problem definition through launch and iteration

  • You combine strong product intuition with analytical rigor

  • You know how to use data, research, user feedback, and experimentation to guide decisions

  • You start with the user problem rather than jumping straight to a feature or solution

  • You have the conviction to form a strong product point of view, make bold calls, and defend them

  • You enjoy working closely with Design and Engineering and leading through influence rather than hierarchy

  • You are comfortable making decisions with imperfect information and changing direction when the evidence tells you to

  • You know how to balance user experience with growth, engagement, monetization, safety, and long-term product health

  • Experience with social, community, social discovery, gaming, recommendation, or consumer subscription products is a plus

Within a month, you will

  • Get familiar with Yubo's product, users, business model, and product principles

  • Build relationships with your Product Designer and key stakeholders across Engineering, Data, Machine Learning, Brand Marketing, and Trust & Safety

  • Understand current product priorities, ongoing experiments, major user journeys, and the metrics behind them

  • Start contributing to discovery and product discussions

Within 3 months, you will

  • Take ownership of a defined product area and its key user and business problems

  • Establish a trusted way of working with your Product Designer and Engineering counterparts

  • Lead your first discovery work and turn your findings into clear product opportunities

  • Launch and analyze your first experiments, using their results to inform your next decisions

Within 6 months, you will

  • Own the strategy and key initiatives for your product area end to end

  • Lead ambitious product bets that rethink meaningful parts of the user experience rather than isolated features

  • Drive measurable progress on outcomes such as retention, engagement, recommendation quality, monetization, or trust

  • Use data, user insight, and experimentation to decide what to scale, iterate, stop, or explore next

  • Raise the bar on product thinking, experimentation, and decision-making across Yubo

The recruitment process

  • Phone screen with Anita, Talent Acquisition

  • First interview with Sacha, our CEO

  • Product case study and debrief with Product Managers

  • Cultural fit assessments

  • And if everything went well, an offer!

What we offer

  • A highly competitive salary range as well as equity in the company

  • A hybrid work policy with up to two days of on-site presence per week at an amazing office and monthly team events to enjoy.

  • We also cover fees for external professional events and meetups (Android Makers, etc…)

  • Great health insurance coverage for both you and your family by Alan, fully paid for by Yubo !

  • Numerous benefits for parents: additional parental leave, easy access to nurseries and daycare facilities in France.

Our approach to privacy & safety

As part of your role, you may handle tools and features involving personal data. We expect all employees to demonstrate strong awareness of privacy and safety issues, and to actively support our Privacy & Safety by Design efforts.

Join Yubo and help shape the future of Social Discovery while enjoying a culture that values flexibility, well-being, and impact.

You own the impact: Step up, adapt, and make it matter

Unconventionally Smart: Hack with intent, borrow smart, build better

Be Bold & Resilient: Raise your head, break barriers, keep moving forward

jobs.description:
New Challenge

About Us
Project Q GmbH ("Q") is a defence technology company with offices in Berlin and Munich, and a trusted partner of the German Armed Forces. Our customers field sensors, drones and C2 systems from many vendors that were never built to work together. We build Hydris, an orchestration layer that integrates the systems they already field, and the ones they'll add next, into one picture operators can act on across defence, public safety, and critical infrastructure. Hydris runs at the edge, keeps working when the link drops, and its core is open source under Apache 2.0.

As Senior Product Manager for Mission Devices, you'll own the hardware that puts Hydris in the field. 

You'll work end-to-end, from discovery with operators through hardware build cycles to fielded units, and you'll decide what gets built rather than work through someone else's backlog. The bar is concrete: devices that run for months off-grid in contested RF environments.

What you'll do
Discovery and requirements

  • Spend time with end users in their operating environment to understand their workflows in depth, not just their stated requirements.
  • Validate assumptions about value, usability, feasibility and viability through prototypes, bench tests and field trials before committing to hardware fabrication.
  • Analyze contractual specifications with Program Managers, separating firm constraints from areas where there's room for the best technical solution.
Roadmap and delivery
  • Maintain an outcome-focused roadmap aligned to hardware build cycles (EVT/DVT/PVT), firmware releases and OTA update pipelines.
  • Define requirements and field metrics for each device, including detection performance, energy efficiency, mission endurance and SWaP, and make the trade-offs between them.
  • Prioritize investment across the device family, deciding where to extend existing devices and where a new one is needed.
Systems and interoperability
  • Make sure devices integrate with Hydris as and interoperate with third-party systems through industry standards and protocols.
  • Design provisioning, commissioning and deployment workflows that are simple and reliable in the field.
  • Investigate issues that span hardware, firmware and communications, and work with engineering to resolve them.
Collaboration
  • Act as the main source of product context and the product's champion, making sure the team, leadership and customers understand what we're building and why.
  • Work in a product trio with engineering (hardware and ML) and design. 
  • Partner with Program and Capture Managers to keep the product vision aligned with contractual commitments.
  • Write clear PRDs and decision records, and mentor teammates on discovery practice and hardware–software trade-offs.

You should apply if you have
  • 5+ years of product management experience with hardware–software products, for example in embedded systems, IoT, robotics, defence systems or edge AI.
  • Experience taking a connected hardware product from EVT/DVT through production into operational use, including in-field updates.
  • Experience running product development end to end, from discovery to engineering-ready work, and the ability to adapt to however a team works.
  • Ability making decisions with incomplete information, and the judgment to know when a decision is risky enough to slow down.
  • Clear communication with hardware engineers, ML researchers and operators alike.
  • Motivation to contribute to European security and sovereignty.
  • Willingness to travel regularly to military exercises, test ranges and customer sites in Germany and NATO partner countries, sometimes in demanding field conditions.
  • Eligibility for German security clearance (SÜ2).
  • Fluency in German and English (C1 or higher).
You'd be a particularly great fit with
  • A degree in electrical, mechanical or systems engineering, robotics or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience bringing hardware products from prototype to production.
  • Experience in military, public safety or other mission-critical operational environments.
  • Exposure to sensor fusion, mesh networking or degraded RF environments, including familiarity with interoperability standards such as Cursor on Target, SAPIENT, ONVIF or ASTERIX.

We Offer
  • Direct feedback from the field: you'll see the products you build tested in real operating environments by the people who use them.
  • Prime Berlin-Mitte location – right between Alexanderplatz and Hackescher Markt.
  • High degree of autonomy and ownership, and flat structure.
  • Annual €1500 Learning & development budget  (available after probation).
  • Bike Leasing and Urban Sports Club membership.
  • 30 days of paid time off.

Note: We're unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role – candidates must already be eligible to work in Germany.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Publisher Payments (f/m/d)
Founding Product Manager
jobs.description:
Hi, we're Dana and Erik, the founders of Circonomit. We build the decision platform industrial companies use to plan their production.

Dana sees the customer side. She needs to know which use cases we can sell today, which we cannot, and what a demo is allowed to claim.

Erik sees the engineering side. He needs requirements that are ready to be built, complete, and clear about what we deliberately leave out.

The product sits between the two, and that is this role. We sell vertically, one use case at a time, while the product has to stay general enough to serve the next customer without being rebuilt. You decide what we build next, in which order, and what we decline.

How you will be measured: how much of today's project work is standard product a year from now, and how quickly a recognised customer problem becomes a usable capability.

We came out of RWTH research, raised €2.8M with Vorwerk Ventures, and have customers running on our models today. Small team, Cologne office.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in product management, or consulting with genuine product proximity. You have owned a product area end to end, not only a backlog.
  • A technical and analytical foundation: engineering, data, operations research, quantitative controlling, or finance with real modelling.
  • You recognise when a requirement creates technical debt or will not be reusable at the next customer. You will not write production code.
  • Experience deciding under incomplete information, and explaining the trade-offs afterwards: what you chose, why, and what it cost.
  • You are comfortable working directly with plant managers and controllers, and understand how they decide today.
  • German at C1 level or above, and fluent English. Customer conversations happen in German.
  • Existing work visa for Germany.

You should enjoy being in front of customers in your first week, and deciding without a research team behind you. Priorities change as we learn from customers, and we make scope and trade-offs explicit together.

Benefits

  • Ownership. The roadmap, and where the line between product and customer project sits.
  • Shaping the role. This is the founding product role. You define how product works here: discovery, prioritisation, and the standards between product and engineering.
  • Exposure. You present your roadmap and the reasoning behind it to the board, and you sit in the core strategy conversations.
  • Real-world impact. Customers plan their production on our models today.
  • Direct collaboration. Small team, no org chart. We work directly together. Weekly feedback, both ways.
  • Compensation. Competitive salary plus a VSOP package reflecting your contribution and development in the role.
  • Hybrid work. Our HQ is in Cologne, and we meet there regularly.
  • Your setup and everyday extras. Hardware of your choice · AI tooling budget · sports membership · Deutschland-Ticket.

Process: An intro call, a second conversation with the team, a 60- to 90-minute live case on a real customer requirement, then in-person conversations with the team.

"Hustle the day, analyse at night, reinforce something outstanding." Period.

Deine Aufgaben

Über die Rolle
Wir suchen dich als Senior Project Manager für unseren großen Kunden aus dem Automobilbereich am Standort Hamburg. Da du intern wie extern die kommunikativen Fäden in der Hand hältst und direkt mit dem Kunden am Tisch sitzt, sind fließende Deutschkenntnisse für diese Rolle deine absolute Basis. Dein Fokus liegt zu einhundert Prozent auf der Betreuung, Pflege und redaktionellen Weiterentwicklung komplexer digitaler Webplattformen. Du verantwortest den langfristigen und nachhaltigen Betrieb unserer digitalen Produkte. Als Senior bist du das strategische und organisatorische Rückgrat für unsere Content Teams sowie UX Designer und stellst sicher, dass neue Inhalte strukturiert, geprüft und pünktlich live gehen.

Deine Aufgaben
Du übernimmst die operative Steuerung und die strategische Planung von großen digitalen Pflegeprojekten sowie weltweiten Content Rollouts. Dabei agierst du als zentrale und souveräne Schnittstelle zwischen dem Kunden, der Kreation und den redaktionellen Teams.
Dein Arbeitsalltag ist geprägt von agilen Methoden. Du übersetzt komplexe inhaltliche Anforderungen in klare Aufgabenpakete, führst das Backlog und koordinierst die Sprints sicher über Jira. Für eine saubere Dokumentation und den transparenten Wissenstransfer nutzt du Confluence.
Du hast ein tiefes Verständnis für Content Management Systeme und steuerst die kontinuierliche Pflege sowie redaktionelle Befüllung der Plattform. Qualität ist für dich kein Zufall. Du planst umfassende Abnahmen für Texteingaben und Bildmaterial und gibst keine neuen Seiten live, die nicht unseren hohen Standards entsprechen.
Du behältst Timings, Ressourcen und Budgets für die kontinuierliche Betreuung der Plattform stets im Blick. Als Senior bewahrst du auch in stressigen Phasen einen kühlen Kopf und leitest dein Projektteam sicher durch komplexe Publikationsprozesse.


Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung: Du hast langjährige Erfahrung im digitalen Projektmanagement gesammelt und dabei große Webplattformen oder redaktionelle Rollouts hauptverantwortlich gesteuert.
  • Plattform Wissen: Du kennst dich hervorragend mit modernen Content Management Systemen aus und verstehst die Prozesse hinter erfolgreicher digitaler Redaktion und Plattformpflege.
  • Agilität: Du bist ein absoluter Profi im Umgang mit agilen Arbeitsweisen und steuerst Workflows routiniert über Jira und Confluence.
  • Leadership: Du sprichst die Sprache der Content Creator genau so fließend wie die der Kunden. Du trittst absolut sicher auf und führst dein Projektteam mit klarer Orientierung.
  • Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest extrem strukturiert, bringst eine hohe Lösungsorientierung mit und bewahrst bei umfassenden Content Rollouts stets die Ruhe.
  • Sprache: Neben deinen fließenden Deutschkenntnissen kommunizierst du auch auf Englisch absolut sicher und verbindlich.


Warum wir?

  • Bei uns erwartet dich ein attraktiver Arbeitsplatz im Herzen von St. Pauli verbunden mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten
  • Du triffst auf eine offene Agenturkultur, die von Kreativität und Menschlichkeit geleitet ist
  • Der respektvolle Umgang miteinander auf Augenhöhe ist bei uns Prinzip
  • Bei uns hast du Eigenverantwortung und wirst zu selbstständigem Arbeiten motiviert
  • Du wirst inhaltlich geführt und hast Raum für deine berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung
  • Du profitierst von unserer globalen DDB-Trainingsplattform mit umfangreichen Fachthemen und Skill-Trainings (u.a. LinkedIn Learning und Babbel)

  • Leckeres Frühstück mit frischem Brot an deinen Bürotagen
  • Du hast die Möglichkeit, regelmäßig von zu Hause zu arbeiten 


Unser Standort

Wir sind in St.Pauli, im Zirkusweg zwischen Reeperbahn und Elbe. Zwischen schreienden Möwen und gemeinsamen Abenden in den berüchtigtsten und liebenswertesten Kneipen auf dem Kiez. Immer im Austausch, gerne auch im 19. Stock. Dann reden wir darüber, was wir noch nicht gesehen haben. Was wir vorhaben und wie wir das zusammen schaffen. Mit viel Vertrauen zueinander und noch mehr Leidenschaft. Wir lieben es Marken digital zu begleiten, zu führen und erfolgreiche Lösungen zu entwickeln. Für Kunden wie zum Beispiel Volkswagen, Lufthansa und IKEA Austria. 

Wir freuen uns auf jeden Menschen. Und auf alle Bewerbungen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion und Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität.

jobs.title: Chief of Staff to the CTO - Engineering
jobs.description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

 

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

 

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

 

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

 

In 2024, we implemented an organizational structure built around business 'tracks'. This approach integrates key stakeholders across marketing, sales, product, and customer care into unified teams focused on specific product lines or client segments. Each track operates as a mini-business, empowered with dedicated resources (e.g., product marketing, data analytics, and operational support) and direct accountability for performance.

 
 

Why this role matters at Pennylane

 

As Chief of Staff to the CTO, you operate as a senior leader in the Tech organisation. Your leverage does not come from managing teams but from owning the hardest problems that sit between them, and from being technical enough to earn the trust of the other engineering leaders.

You are the person the CTO trusts with ambiguous, org-wide problems. You turn that ambiguity into a clear framing, a decision, an owner and a measurable outcome.

This is not a coordination role. You are expected to have opinions on engineering strategy, staffing choices and technical trade-offs, and to defend them in front of the Tech leadership team.

 

Team and Context

Pennylane's Tech organisation is 70+ squads, each led by an Engineering Manager working with a PM and a Product Designer. We serve 1.5m+ customers and we want to scale in Europe. At that size, the hard problems are no longer inside a squad: how the organisation plans, how it decides, how it measures itself, how it invests in foundations without stalling product delivery. That is your perimeter.

You report directly to Quentin, Co-founder & CTO. Your influence comes from the scope of what you own and from credibility with senior engineering leaders, which is why we ask for a technical background. As the organisation grows, this role can evolve towards a management position.

Key missions

Engineering strategy and transversal initiatives

  • Own the strategic, cross-organization initiatives that no single squad can carry: platform or architecture programmes, reliability and quality step-changes, engineering productivity, technical debt paydown

  • Frame the problem, build the technical and business case, secure alignment across Engineering, Product and Security to drive execution

  • Lead the Tech side of company-level programmes (e.g. European expansion, major compliance or infrastructure shifts) alongside the rest of the Tech leadership

Planning & Performance tracking

  • Own the Tech planning cycle: collect the inputs, surface the trade-offs (capacity vs. platform, run vs. new bets), and drive the arbitration with Tech leadership

  • Drive the definition and calibration of Tech OKRs, and hold the organisation accountable

  • Define what "good" looks like for a 70+ squad engineering organization and build the metrics that measure it (delivery cadence, reliability, quality, staffing and attrition, engineering satisfaction)

Decision-making and leadership cadence

  • Own the Tech leadership operating system: staff meetings, QBRs, roadmap and architecture reviews. You design them, set the agenda, write or commission the pre-reads, frame the decisions to be made, and make sure decisions land

  • Maintain the CTO's decision log: what was decided, by whom, with what trade-off, and what happened next

  • Raise the quality of decision-making across the Tech leadership team

Communication

  • Lead internal and operational communications across the engineering organization, building clear messaging systems from board decks down to team-wide updates

Who you’ll work with?

  • CTO and Tech leadership (Head of Engineering / Head of Data / Senior Engineering Managers)

  • Rest of the leadership (CPO, VP Strategic Initiatives)

  • Other relevant teams (e.g. Security, Finance, People)

Who we’re looking for

Must-have

  • An engineering degree (engineering, computer science or equivalent scientific curriculum)

  • Technical fluency: you can read a design doc, follow an architecture discussion, challenge an estimate or a trade-off, and be taken seriously by senior engineers

  • 7-10 years of experience, including significant time inside a tech organisation at scale (multiple squads, platform teams), where you have lived the problems of scaling engineering

  • A track record of owning complex, cross-organisational initiatives from framing to measurable outcome with senior stakeholders

  • Outstanding written communication: this role produces documents that senior people act on

  • Fluency in English

Nice-to-have

  • A hands-on engineering past: software engineer, engineering manager, Technical Program Manager, architect or equivalent

  • Experience as a Chief of Staff, VP/Director of Engineering Operations, or in a strategy & operations function inside a product-led tech company

What you can expect?

Within one month

  • You'll complete the company and Tech onboarding, including our application, accounting domain and engineering practices

  • You'll have met the Tech leadership team and formed your own view of where the organisation loses time, quality or alignment

  • You'll have taken ownership of the leadership cadence and the next planning milestone

Within 3-6 months

  • You'll be leading selected org-wide strategic initiatives end-to-end, with a measurable target

  • The Tech organisation will have a metrics picture it trusts and uses to make decisions

  • You'll be a recognised voice in the senior tech community at Pennylane, consulted on decisions rather than just informed of them

  • You'll be shaping the engineering narrative that the rest of the company and the board hear

Recruitment Process

- Screening interview with Barbara - Senior Recruiter (30 mins)

- An interview with Eric - VP Strategic Initiatives (1h)

- A Business Case to prepare at home and to present (1h)

- A final interview with Quentin - CTO (45 mins)

What do we do to make your work life easier

 

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

 

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

 

Who are we looking for ?

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :

-To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)

-To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment

-To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)

-Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity

 

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

 

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scam attempts are on the rise. We invite you to remain vigilant during your exchanges.

Applications through official channels only : apply exclusively through our job postings published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages).

(bank details, payment for an interview, equipment purchases, etc.) as part of the recruitment process. If such a request is made to you, it is fraudulent. We invite you to not respond and to report it to us immediately.

 

We also want to emphasize that we fully embrace diversity, equity and inclusion and that we’re doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment.

We are committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disabilities, or any other traits that make you who you are. If anything, diversity makes us a more fun place to work at.

Curious about supporting a team working on real launch missions? Then Exolaunch might be the perfect place for you. 
 
Exolaunch is a global leader in launch mission management, satellite integration and satellite deployment technologies. With a decade of flight heritage and over 830 satellites launched across 48 missions to date, Exolaunch leverages industry insight to tailor turnkey solutions that meet customer needs and respond to market trends. The company fulfills launch contracts for industry leaders, the world's most innovative startups, research institutions, government organizations, and international space agencies.

Key to our success is a combination of an expert Mission Management team, our growing portfolio of in-house designed and market leading separation systems, and our rideshare structures including EXOtube. Rideshare structures are the answer to a growing diversification of launch opportunities coupled with a market seeking flexible and agile access to space for a growing number of satellite constellations. The EXOtube Product Manager is a multi-faceted role which combines technical management of complex development and launch planning projects with customer and market facing Business Development and Sales work. You will be coordinating the development and qualification of EXOtube projects, becoming intimately familiar with how our products function and how we execute our missions. You will also help the business team in marketing and selling EXOtube projects, shaping how it is seen on the market and helping us identify market demand.

Your role is based at our headquarters in Berlin, Germany. The ideal candidate for this role has a background in space technology, structural design and environmental testing for space, is an excellent communicator and team player, and is passionate about being part of a dynamic team that is driving the satellite industry forward.


Your mission

  • Manage the requirements, design, qualification and launch planning of EXOtube projects.

  • Attend space conferences and industry events – represent Exolaunch at the highest professional level

  • Gather customer requirements and work with the engineering teams to iterate on and improve Exolaunch product offerings and cultivate new business opportunities.


Your profile

Carpool Experience covers everything between two members once they have found each other: agreeing on the trip, talking, meeting up, and building trust.

Vision: a carpool experience that feels easy and safe for passengers and drivers, from the first hello to the final goodbye.

Mission: make it simple for members to talk, negotiate, meet up and trust each other.

It launched in France in 2025 and went worldwide in 2026. It is still a new product: what it should become, and how far it can go, is yours to figure out.

About Qorelo

Almost every large company in the DACH region is facing the same task: the transformation to SAP S/4HANA. These programmes run for years, cost tens of millions, and regularly stall at the same point — nobody fully understands the legacy landscape that has grown over decades.

That is where Qorelo comes in. We are building the AI layer for S/4HANA transformation: we read code, processes and documentation, make the existing landscape transparent, and deliver the fit-to-standard analysis in weeks instead of months. The knowledge stays with the customer afterwards — including in day-to-day operations, long after the system integrators have moved on.

We've raised $3.5M from HPI Ventures, the fund tied to the institute of SAP co-founder Hasso Plattner, along with other strong backers. We already work with Fortune 500 and DAX 40 companies, including Mercedes-Benz.

The role

You'll be the person who decides what we build next, and why. You'll lead our two solution architects — the people who carry our SAP domain depth — and turn what they know about real transformation projects into a roadmap our engineers can ship. You'll work in close collaboration with our Head of Product Design and the engineering team, and you'll spend real time with the people who use the product: consultants, IT leads, and transformation teams inside enterprise clients.

This is an early-stage PM role in the full sense: strategy and backlog, customer discovery and acceptance criteria, the big roadmap call and the unglamorous ticket. You'll do IC work alongside the thinking, and your decisions will show up in the product within weeks, running inside some of the largest SAP landscapes in Europe.

  • The solution architects. You lead our two SAs directly, turning their module knowledge and project scar tissue into product requirements engineering can build against.

  • Discovery with real users. Consultants and enterprise IT teams use Qorelo inside live transformation programmes. You sit with them, watch where the product wins and where it fails, and bring that back as decisions, not just notes.

  • The bridge between domain and build. SAP depth on one side, an AI-native engineering team on the other. You speak enough of both languages that nothing gets lost in translation — and you work with our Head of Product Design so what we ship is usable by SAP people, not just correct.

  • Shipping. Specs, acceptance criteria, tradeoffs, cut lines. Features reach real users on real landscapes, and you own whether they landed.

What you need

  • 4+ years hands-on SAP experience, functional or product side — S/4HANA transformation, fit-to-standard, and module-level depth in at least one core area like FI, SD, or PP

  • 2+ years product experience: you've owned a roadmap, prioritized with engineering, and shipped features to real users — title doesn't matter, ownership does

  • Understanding of the SAP transformation lifecycle (Discover → Prepare → Explore → Realize) deep enough to talk credibly to consultants and IT leads at enterprise clients

  • Strong AI curiosity — you've actually built or worked with LLM/agentic tooling, not just read about it

  • Comfort in an early-stage environment: ambiguity, speed, IC work alongside strategy

  • Fluent English; German is a plus for our DACH client base

You might be a fit if

  • You've sat inside an S/4HANA programme and thought "half of this should be software" — and can name which half

  • You've been the person consultants trust on module questions and the person engineers trust to write a clear spec

  • You've built something with LLMs — a prototype, an internal tool, an agent — and formed opinions about where they break

  • You want your product decisions to run inside DAX 40 landscapes within weeks, not sit in a committee for quarters

What we offer

  • Real ownership. Meaningful equity and a direct hand in the company's direction, not just your backlog. We're looking for people who want to shape a company, not join one.

  • Competitive salary, benchmarked for senior product talent in Berlin.

  • The problems. Fortune 500 and DAX 40 production landscapes, including Mercedes-Benz. Your roadmap decisions run at the core of companies most PMs only read about.

  • The team. Short paths, fast decisions, and a direct line to the engineers and architects who build what you define.

  • 25 days paid vacation plus German public holidays.

Location: Remote Germany or hybrid in Cluj (Romania)

  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience in product design in a dynamic environment, ideally with B2B or SaaS products

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Customer Success Engineering
Director Business and Digital Product Development (m/w/d): win business and drive platform building
jobs.description:
Vicoland gives the professional services market a new dimension: Virtual Companies – “Vicos”. We invented Vicos as a new type of supplier, more efficient than traditional professional services firms (consultancies, system integrators, agencies etc.). We have received 20 million € in round A financing.

Vicos may consist of freelancers, SMEs and AI agents. They organize through our AI-driven SaaS platform to act like real companies, competing successfully for large enterprise projects, e. g. ERP introductions or AI transformations. Vicos have proven to be more cost-efficient and to deliver better quality than traditional companies.

Already, 120+ Vicos with thousands of freelancers work on projects for enterprise clients like BASF, Miele, Siemens or Daimler and many SMEs. They also serve leading professional services firms as subcontractors, including Accenture, Infosys and Roland Berger. Forbes and Forrester have named Vicoland as a leading force transforming the market.

Our certified platform is key to our success. It provides the full digital infrastructure which makes Vicos come true as a new form to organize human labor and human-agentic interaction. It covers end-to-end all essential areas: marketing, finance, legal, and organization.

Given its ambitious and transformative purpose, our platform is highly complex (though easy to use). Developing it further takes people who understand what the entrepreneurs on our platform, the Vico Leads, need: they must be able to run their Vico end-to-end without overhead and with minimal effort.

We are scaling our go-to-market and need a leader who wins new business for our Vicos and makes sure our platform does what Vico Leads need.

Our offer to you

As Director Business and Digital Product Development you combine three capabilities:

• Business development: you win new clients and business for our Vicos

• Digital product development: you turn user needs into requirements that our engineers turn into platform capabilities

• Entrepreneurial drive in building a hyper-scaling business: this is about continuously driving the perfection of our product, go-to-market, processes and tools

You join our go-to-market team and work closely with our platform building team. Your work directly affects how well thousands of freelance experts can run their own companies on our platform.

Tasks

Shape the market

• Position Vicoland with enterprise clients as the strategic alternative to traditional professional services models.

• Question established sourcing models and demonstrate why Vicos deliver better outcomes.

• Develop go-to-market strategies tailored to specific client contexts.

• Build thought leadership through events and LinkedIn presence.

Win and grow clients

• Develop and own a portfolio of enterprise clients and partners – from strategic outreach through close to long-term expansion.

• Win new business together with Vico Leads, and learn from every deal what the platform must do better.

Lead and enable Vico Leads

• Be the go-to person for Vico Leads on the platform: help them solve problems, and bring in engineering where needed.

• Supervise and coach Vico Leads in your client group – hold them accountable for delivery quality and commercial performance.

• Activate new Vico Leads and help them grow their own marketplace business on the platform.

Continuously define the platform and shape the company

• Translate the real problems, needs and workflows of Vico Leads into concrete requirements and feature requests for our engineering team.

• Prioritize features by impact on business and shape the platform roadmap.

• Follow each feature to release, check whether it works for Vico Leads, and drive our NPS.

• Bring market intelligence, client feedback, and competitive insight into the organization and our product.

• Help define how we scale: processes, tools, talent, culture.

Requirements

• 5+ years in professional services (e. g. consulting, system integration, sales of complex products) or in a product-driven start-up or scale-up.

• Proven consultative selling capacity: you can win complex enterprise deals by advising, not pitching.

• Solid understanding of digital products: you like working with users and engineers alike and you can define requirements that engineers can make real.

• Thorough and pragmatic: you think problems through and deliver concrete results.

• Challenger mindset: you shape how clients and the market at large think about professional services sourcing and are comfortable challenging senior stakeholders.

• AI-affinity: you actively use AI tools and understand the strategic implications of agentic AI for professional services.

• Entrepreneurial energy – you are drawn to building markets, not administering existing ones. Own entrepreneurial experience is a strong plus.

• Strong academic background, fast career progression, proven commercial impact.

• Fluent in German and English (DACH is our home market, while we expand internationally).

• Network power: you have and build valuable relationships easily.

Benefits

• Attractive compensation with fixed salary, variable component tied to the commercial success of your Vicos, and company shares (ESOP in place).

• Entrepreneurial key position in an industry-transforming company with direct impact on company results, the market, and your personal growth.

• High degree of autonomy in how you develop your client portfolio, work with Vico Leads and shape the product.

• Fast-paced environment with a highly talented team of diverse backgrounds and top-notch qualifications.

• Flexibility in how and where you work – remote and/or from one of our offices (Frankfurt, Barcelona, Berlin, Seville).

Product Manager - Preclinical Device
jobs.description:
Location: London, with occasional travel.

 

About Netholabs

Netholabs builds large-scale neural and behavioural recording platforms to generate the data needed for the next generation of brain models. We operate two recording platforms: a preclinical ethological monitoring system integrated with behaviour and neural data and a human motion-capture and neurophysiology platform. We are a small, fast-moving team where hardware, neuroscience, and ML sit in the same room.

 

The Role

We are building integrated human motion-capture and neurophysiological recording systems for both controlled lab studies and naturalistic, in-the-wild data collection. Today we have working prototypes. We need someone to turn them into products - reproducible, manufacturable, remotely updatable systems that can be deployed at scale and maintained without an engineer in the room.

You will own R&D delivery across the London lab and hardware programme: co-developing the hardware with our electronics and mechanical engineers, importing and enforcing best-practice data capture protocols, and engaging contract manufacturers to scale. This is an agentic, hands-on role -with support engineer roles as required. You will spend as much time in the lab and on the phone with suppliers as you will in a spec document.

 

What you'll do

  • Take working prototypes to shippable, field-deployable systems — define the product, own the roadmap, and drive it to delivery

  • Specify and build out over-the-air update infrastructure: firmware, versioning, rollback, fleet management, remote diagnostics

  • Own the design-for-manufacture transition — DFM/DFA reviews, BOM ownership, tolerancing, test fixtures, and production test protocols

  • Identify, qualify, and manage contract manufacturers and suppliers; own the relationship from RFQ through NPI to sustained production

  • Establish and enforce best-practice data capture protocols across modalities (EEG, fNIRS, EMG, pupillometry, motion capture, video) so that data quality is consistent across sessions, operators, and sites

  • Define the requirements that make in-the-wild collection viable: wearability, session setup time, robustness, battery life, and unattended operation

  • Work directly with our electronics, mechanical, firmware, and neuroscience teams to translate research needs into hardware requirements — and push back when a requirement doesn't survive contact with manufacturing

  • Build the quality, documentation, and regulatory groundwork (design history, ISO 13485-style discipline, CE/UKCA pathway) appropriate to a research-device product

  • Contribute to the industrialisation of our rodent recording platform where the manufacturing and OTA problems overlap

     

What we're looking for

Essential

  • Min 3+ years (ideal 7+) in hardware product management, product engineering, or programme management, with several products you personally took from prototype to volume manufacture

  • Direct, demonstrable experience with contract manufacturers: you have run RFQs, sat through NPI builds, argued about yield, and fixed a production line problem from 6,000 miles away

  • Deep understanding of connected-device architecture: OTA update mechanisms, device provisioning, telemetry, fleet management, and what it costs to get these wrong

  • Fluency across electronics, mechanical, and firmware enough to hold a real technical conversation with each - you don't need to design the board, but you need to know when the answer you're getting is wrong

  • Track record of writing specifications and protocols that people actually follow

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a small-company reality: no PMO, no roadmap tooling team, no one to delegate the boring parts to

Strongly preferred

  • Experience with wearable, biosignal, or medical device hardware

  • Familiarity with human research data collection — protocols, participant handling, IRB/ethics, GDPR and special-category data

  • Experience shipping a product to CE/UKCA or FDA pathway

  • Background in neuroscience, biomedical engineering, or a related field

  • Experience with multi-sensor time synchronisation and the data infrastructure behind it

What we offer

  • Direct ownership of a product line at a company small enough that your decisions ship

  • Equity in an early-stage company building foundational infrastructure for brain modelling

  • A team of neuroscientists and engineers doing genuinely novel work

  • Central London lab, on-site, with access to the Sussex rodent facility

To apply: send a CV and a short note about a product you took from prototype to manufacture what broke, and what you did about it.

Senior Web Engineer (React) - Remote Friendly
jobs.description:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).

Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


🌏 Location: You can choose to work in Qonto as long as you're living in (or willing to relocate to) either Germany, France, Italy, Serbia, or Spain.
 
Mission: Join us as a Web Engineer to craft the web apps that 600,000+ European SMEs rely on every day, from the customer-facing features that make finance simpler to the design system powering every pixel of our product.

➡️ As a Web Engineer at Qonto, you will

  • Craft new features for our customers within a squad Team, owning quality from design to production.
  • Grow in technical leadership: lead design discussions, contribute to guild-wide improvement, and raise the bar for developer experience across your peers
  • Be a key player in teamwork with Product, Design, and other Tech stacks
  • Work AI-first: use AI as a default part of how you explore the codebase, draft technical designs, prototype solutions, and accelerate delivery, while keeping strong human judgment and quality standards

➡️  What you can expect: our methodology, the Qonto Way

  • At Qonto, we value diversity and are proud to have 33% non-male in our Frontend guild.
  • You will contribute to and use our own design system and UI library, which we built from scratch.
  • You will be part of a team that is driven by quality. Our org assigns one team lead per project across stacks, giving your team a clear mission and full autonomy on how it operates
  • You will have access to best-in-class AI tools (e.g., Claude / Claude Code and internal workflows) and the autonomy to experiment, share learnings, and help scale what works across the guild
  • You will bring your energy and skills to improve the team’s tools and processes at many levels, contributing to a better developer experience for all your peers.
You can watch this interview of Imen, who joined the team as a Lead in January 2023.
 

➡️  Your future team

As a Web Engineer, you'll join one of Qonto's squad teams, each with a clear project mission, one team lead, and full product ownership.
You'll be part of a 100+ strong Frontend community within a 500+ Product Engineering department, working in teams of 5 to 10 people alongside Product, Design, and peers from Backend and Mobile.
 
We hold ourselves to high standards, and we've shipped several open-source JS libraries along the way. 

➡️ About You

To succeed as a Web Engineer at Qonto, you will need to demonstrate:
  1. Proficiency in frontend engineering: you have at least three years of professional experience using React.js, as well as HTML and CSS. We don’t use CSS libraries such as Tailwind, so you will need to know how to write pure CSS.
  2. Attention to detail: you strive for excellence in every aspect of your job. You don’t gloss over minor issues and you understand that great work is the accumulation of many small things done right.
  3. Communication skills: you explain your thoughts in a clear, organized, concise and accurate manner.
  4. AI fluency & good judgment: you can leverage AI to move faster (research, writing, coding, testing) while staying critical, validating outputs, and protecting the product’s reliability and user trust
At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick — who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.
 
By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice for full details.
 
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here
 
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Recruitment scams are on the rise. Keep in mind, we will never work with third-party platforms or agencies that request payment from candidates.
