jobs.title: Senior UX Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Orbital is the AI platform for real estate legal work.

Real estate shapes the world around us: our homes, our workplaces and our cultural landmarks. It’s the infrastructure that powers everyday life and is the world's largest asset class. Yet behind every single deal, real estate and legal teams work hard to navigate decades-old complexity; manually connecting documents, hidden obligations, geo-spatial context, and multiple parties into a path forward. We connect the legal and physical record, so that path is clearer than ever before. Our mission is to make real estate transactions faster, clearer, and less manual.

Here, you'll be part of changing how the deals behind the largest asset class get transacted, and will help shape the future of real estate.

A bit about us:

🚀 We’re building at the forefront of AI technology, without losing the deeply human expertise our clients depend on.

🏢 Orbital is built with former practising real estate lawyers and 250+ years of combined legal expertise. We're purpose-built for the complexity of real estate: accelerating due diligence, drafting and negotiation, and deal coordination with legal-grade precision.

💰 We've just raised a $60m Series B, led by Brighton Park Capital, to accelerate our global expansion – $75m raised to date.

🤝 We're trusted by 5,000+ real estate professionals, spanning UK Magic Circle and US Am Law 100 firms, to household names like M&S. Leading firms like BCLP, Orrick, Goodwin, Womble Bond Dickinson and Clifford Chance rely on Orbital to remove the busywork, freeing legal and real estate teams to focus on sharp judgment, standout client service, and closing deals faster.

💡 Working at Orbital means joining a bold, ambitious team, with the trust to take ownership and make a real impact from day one.

Role Overview 🔎

As a Senior UX Design Engineer, you'll own some of the hardest problems in our product and see them through until they're solved. You'll join our design team, three designers today and growing, and work inside our teams alongside product managers and our product, legal and AI engineers (our legal engineers are former real estate lawyers).

We've built a product that real estate lawyers rely on, and now we're also building for the businesses that own, occupy and develop property. You'll work across both, and much of it is new ground. Nobody here has the full answer yet, and that's the job: you'll get to know the people we build for, work out what they need from us, and build it.

This role is not about polishing screens. Our product is live and trusted by some of the most demanding real estate lawyers and property teams in the world. The hardest design problems here are not about how it looks. They are about whether people can trust it and get their work done.

Your starting point is the users, their work and the product: you notice what isn't working, decide what matters most, and see it through, from the first customer conversation to the version they use.

Here, designers build what they design. With AI coding tools, you'll build your designs into the product yourself, often live for customers the next day. When anyone can build, judgement matters most, and that is the heart of this role.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Find out who you're building for: talk to customers and map who does what inside law firms and property businesses. You'll do it together with the wider team.

  • Design how people work with our AI agents, which do real work on their behalf: what people hand over, how they check it and see where each answer came from, when they step in, what the agent asks about first and what it simply does, and how that shifts as AI improves.

  • Solve first, then refine: get to the right answer with rough, working versions in front of real people, and add polish once the problem is solved.

  • Build and ship interface changes yourself, using AI coding tools in our codebase. Engineering depth is welcome, not required.

  • Keep the product coherent while everyone builds: engineers, legal engineers, product people and coding agents all build interfaces here. Explain why one option beats another so people can make the call themselves, write it down as clear, reusable rules in the codebase for agents to follow, and evolve our design system so it all still feels like one product.


New to design engineering? 🌱

Design engineering is still a new kind of role, and most great candidates won't have had the title. If you're a strong designer with a good sense of product, and you're excited about building what you design, we'd love to hear from you. We'll help you make the shift.

You should apply if: ✍️

  • You go after the hard problem, not the surface one, and own it until it's solved. You judge your work by whether people use it, rely on it and come back.

  • You're comfortable not knowing yet. You form a view, test it with real people, and change it when they tell you something different.

  • You bring design excellence and strong product sense: hierarchy, layout, type, copy, states, navigation and flow, and a clear view of what is worth building.

  • You've designed for experts, people who know their field better than any designer will. You reach for patterns they already know, and never talk down to them.

  • You can say why. You make a call and ship it without waiting for sign-off, explain it in words others can reuse, and change your mind for a good reason. You'd rather guide people than overrule them.

  • You're genuinely excited about AI: what it can do, where it's heading and how to get the most out of it. You already design or build with AI tools, at work or in your own projects, and you want to help shape how AI changes the working day of property professionals.

  • You want to learn how property and legal work gets done. No legal or property knowledge needed.

  • You have owned and shipped product design work, and can walk us through the problem, not just the result.

Desirable

  • Experience designing AI products: showing the reasoning behind an answer, signalling confidence, and letting people steer an agent.

  • Experience in legal tech, fintech, compliance or another field where precision and professional accountability shape every decision.

  • Side projects, hackathons or things you've built outside work.

  • Design systems and accessibility experience.

  • Experience at an early-stage or fast-scaling startup, where there was no established process and you helped create one.

Reasons we might not be for you

  • The pace is fast and our ways of working keep evolving. If you prefer clear boundaries between design and engineering, this may not be the role for you.

  • You'll spend most of your time on hard, unsolved problems and on building, not on perfecting polished mock-ups.

Why you'll love it here

  • You'll join a collaborative, highly ambitious team where the standard is high and the ownership is real.

  • You'll help shape how design works in a company where AI builds alongside people.

  • Your work is used by lawyers and property teams on real deals and real buildings.

How we hire

  1. A short call with our recruiter.

  2. A 30-minute video call with the hiring manager.

  3. A design task.

  4. A 90-minute panel: you'll walk us through your task, then meet people from across the company.

  5. A final conversation with our CTO.

Read more

  • Everyone Ships Code Now

  • Our Product Engineering Guide

Benefits 🌟

  • 💰 Competitive salary

  • 🏢 Equity options in a fast-growing startup

  • 🌴 25 days holiday plus bank holidays

  • 📚 £1,000 personal development budget and learning opportunities

  • 🏥 Company pension, healthcare, eye care and enhanced parental leave

🔒 Security is everyone’s responsibility at Orbital. We ask all team members to follow our security policies, complete regular awareness training, and handle sensitive data with care in line with ISO 27001 standards. Spot something unusual? Reporting risks or incidents quickly helps us maintain the strong culture of security and compliance we all depend on.

💡 At Orbital, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We especially welcome applications from people who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. Even if you don’t meet every single requirement, or if the right role isn’t listed yet, we’d still love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Founding Product Designer
jobs.description:
Founding Product Designer (UX/UI & Research)

London (Hybrid) | Full-time | £70 - £85K + early-team equity


The role

We’re a well-funded startup building category-defining AI for architecture, engineering and construction: an archaic industry at a critical juncture. The Building Safety Act now requires firms to evidence their design decisions, and directors carry personal liability.

Join Bite as our first in-house designer working strategically and directly with the head of product, founders and engineering team, you’ll own the entire design function and lead the transformation of our beta into a high-quality user experience that shapes the future of Bite’s AI for the built environment.

Why join Bite

The problem is genuinely hard. When a structural engineer changes a component in their building design model, the same component exists in drawings, schedules, specs and emails under different names, in different formats, some of which LLMs don’t understand, and with no shared identifier. Detecting these changes, predicting the downstream impacts and propagating them using AI under the engineer's supervision is the core of our product.

You'll own the UX/UI for the whole product, not a slice of it. There's no design team to inherit and no feature factory to work around. You set the direction, the patterns and the quality bar, and you'll prototype, test and ship rapidly with a small team that can pivot, fast.

Your work ships to people who pay. The beta is in production with signed customers that include some of the UK's leading structural engineering firms who are keen to build with us. With our tight feedback loops, you’ll have plenty of data to help drive your design decisions.

What we're building

Structural engineers work across numerous, fragmented sets of tools with no shared source of truth. When a design changes, propagating that change across files is manual, slow and error-prone, and the errors are expensive.

Bite is the change management and audit trail layer for structural engineering. The platform does three things that today take weeks of manual work: natural-language search across a project's entire file ecosystem, cross-file impact detection e.g. "I changed Column C7 in the structural model - what drawings, schedules, and specs are now out of date?" and propagation of those changes to every affected file.


What you’ll do

  • Set the design direction for our products and raise the overall bar for craft and quality.

  • Establish and scale our design foundations, including the design system and UI patterns.

  • Shape the visual identity and brand across every customer touchpoint.

  • Partner with customers to shape product vision, design strategy, and the experience roadmap.

  • Collaborate with the head of product, founders and engineering team to define problems, explore solution spaces, validate concepts, ensure technical feasibility and ship product improvements that move the metrics that matter.

  • Analyse product performance to identify friction points and drive iterative optimisation, aligning business goals with user-centred product opportunities.

  • Lead comprehensive user research, including interviews, surveys, behavioural analysis, prototype testing, and usability studies, to identify user needs, confirm concepts, and produce actionable insights.

  • Translate insights, data, and business needs into user journeys, wireframes, prototypes and ultimately end-to-end, intuitive design solutions that drive meaningful improvements.

  • Facilitate workshops to build shared understanding and present design decisions clearly to influence strategic, experience-led discussions.

  • Encode the judgment and complexity required for complex workflows under the hood, while keeping the user experience simple and seamless.

  • Stay current on emerging AI trends and product patterns. Build a clear point of view on what matters, and bring that perspective into how we design at Bite.

What we need from you

  • A senior or lead product designer with 5+ years of experience (preferably shipping high-quality B2B products, with expertise in AI products).

  • An autonomous, opinionated builder who is comfortable being the sole designer and enjoys facilitating design sprints and principles within an engineering team.

  • A creative excited to work in a fast-paced startup environment.

  • A proven IC track record of expertise across UX/UI research, including interviews, surveys, usability testing, behavioural analysis, and the ability to translate insights into end-to-end digital experiences at scale.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills and fluency in data, using qualitative and quantitative signals to validate design decisions, measure impact, and inform tradeoffs.

  • Evidence of shipping work that moved real business or operational metrics, and an ability to talk about those numbers fluently.

  • Demonstrated understanding of human-centred design principles and usability best practices, responsive design, product, technical, and business constraints in real-world environments.

  • Demonstrable ability to build intuitive, user-centred experiences supported by a portfolio showing strong interaction design foundation, high-quality visual craft and attention to detail, structured problem framing and systems thinking.

  • Advanced experience working with AI-native research, design, and collaboration tools and advanced proficiency in Figma.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear, concise, customer-ready documentation.

  • Ability to move fluidly between the big question (what should this experience do?) and the craft-level detail that makes high-stakes decisions feel simple.

  • Highly organised and adaptable, able to balance critical thinking with hands-on delivery, while contributing to the evolution of the design system and culture.

  • Experience working autonomously to design complex, multi-step product flows.

What you can expect from us

  • Flexible, hybrid working

  • Genuine ownership and an open and creative environment where you’ll help us define the future of Bite, what we work on and our culture

  • Passionate, growth-minded people with an entrepreneurial mindset and the confidence to operate autonomously within a fast-moving startup environment

jobs.description:
About Qorelo

Almost every company running SAP faces the same task: the transformation to S/4HANA. These programmes run for years, cost millions, and regularly stall at the same point — nobody fully understands the legacy landscape that has grown over decades.

That is where Qorelo comes in. Qorelo is an AI agent platform that integrates natively into your SAP landscape and deeply understands your business processes and workflows. Its agents read code, processes and documentation, surface requirements, map scope, and deliver the fit-to-standard analysis in weeks instead of months. We take a target-architecture-first approach — decide what the end state should look like before touching the system, then get there in a fraction of the time a traditional programme takes. Most of the market treats greenfield as the risky option, the one you talk clients out of. We treat it as the fastest route to a clean core, and we run the same discipline on brownfield programmes.

We've raised $3.5M from HPI Ventures, the fund tied to the institute of SAP co-founder Hasso Plattner, along with other strong backers. We already work with Fortune 500 and DAX 40 companies, including Mercedes-Benz, and we sell to enterprise customers across DACH as well as to selected SAP consultancies who use Qorelo in their own client projects.

The role

You will be one of the first sellers on the team, and you own your accounts end to end — from first touch to signature. We have a product with a clear business case, a defined target market, a pricing model that holds up, and a sales playbook you can run from day one. What we need is someone who turns that into pipeline and revenue.

You will work closely with the Head of Sales, as well as with product and our engineers, and you will have a direct line to the people who build what you sell.

What you'll own

  • The full sales cycle. You build your own pipeline, qualify, run discovery and demos, drive the Proof of Value and negotiate the close — no SDR teeing it up for you, no handover to a closing team.

  • Selling to decision makers. CIOs, Heads of SAP, transformation leads and procurement — you get them into the same room.

  • MEDDICC as your sales motion. You quantify the business case in the customer's own numbers (Metrics), get to the Economic buyer instead of stopping at the sponsor, understand the Decision criteria and the Decision process including procurement, security and works council, map the Paper process early, qualify the Identified pain hard enough to know whether the deal is real, build a Champion who sells internally when you are not in the room, and position against the Competition — including the customer's option to do nothing.

  • Honest qualification. MEDDICC is how we forecast, not paperwork. Gaps in your deal are visible in the CRM, and walking away from a deal that will not close is a good outcome, not a failure.

  • Technical sales cycles. You steer fit-to-standard Proof of Value engagements, security and data protection reviews, and questions around on-premise and cloud deployment together with our team.

  • Negotiating and closing. Multi-year agreements, framework contracts, ramp deals, procurement rounds — you hold the line on value instead of discounting your way to a signature.

  • A forecast we can plan on. You keep Attio, our CRM, clean and current, and your forecast holds up.


What you need

  • Several years of SaaS sales experience selling to enterprise customers with multi-month sales cycles

  • A demonstrable track record of not just hitting but exceeding ambitious revenue targets — you can walk us through your numbers for the past few years

  • Ownership mentality: you run the full sales cycle from first outreach to signed contract

  • Confident negotiation at executive level in German and English (German at native level)

  • Experience selling AI products and the ability to translate technical value into a business case that survives a CFO review

  • You use AI tools in your day-to-day sales work — research, prep, outreach, follow-up — and you are curious about what they can take off your plate next

  • Self-driven pipeline generation: outbound, network, events — you do not wait for leads

  • Willingness to travel within DACH for on-site customer meetings


You might be a fit if

  • You have worked with MEDDICC or another structured qualification framework, and you can tell us not only where it helped you close a deal, but where it helped you drop one early

  • You know the SAP ecosystem — or you have sold into complex, technical evaluation processes and learned the domain fast

  • You have been an early sales hire at a fast-growing startup and want that again, with more ownership

  • You have an existing network among IT decision makers in DACH


What we offer

  • Real ownership. Meaningful equity and a direct hand in the company's direction, not just your quota. We're looking for people who want to shape a company, not join one.

  • Competitive salary with uncapped commission — your ceiling is set by your pipeline, not by a plan.

  • A market with a deadline. Moving to S/4HANA is not optional for thousands of companies, and the product you sell solves a problem enterprises cannot solve on their own — with Mercedes-Benz already proving it in production.

  • The team. Short paths, fast decisions, real influence on product and go-to-market, and a direct line to the engineers who build what you sell.

  • 25 days paid vacation + region-specific public holidays.

  • Company offsites with the whole team.

  • An office at the Wasserturm in Prenzlauer Berg — and the flexibility to work where you are most effective. The fridge is stocked.

  • Wellhub Gold membership, top-tier equipment and access to the latest AI tools.


Hiring process

  1. Intro call with Reza (30 min)

  2. Deep dive on your track record and sales methodology with Marcel, our Head of Sales (60 min)

  3. Practical case: discovery and pitch simulation with Marcel and Louis, our CEO

  4. Offer


How to apply

Send us your CV at ----- — no cover letter needed, but we would love two or three sentences about your strongest deal of the past two years.

Qorelo is an equal opportunity employer. We make our decisions regardless of gender, age, origin, religion, disability or sexual identity.

jobs.title: People Analytics Analyst
jobs.description:
People Analytics Analyst

About Us

ClearBank is a technology-enabled bank built to help transform banking and payments. We combine banking expertise and technology to provide infrastructure that enables our clients to deliver innovative financial products and services. Our culture is founded on trust, accountability, learning, collaboration and the confidence to challenge established ways of working responsibly.

We built ClearBank on the belief that banking infrastructure would no longer slow down progress. Instead, it would be a catalyst that unlocks the potential to innovate. It would adapt to different needs so a new era in financial services could begin. We’re here to challenge the status quo in banking, are you?

We all know that transforming banking forever is not an easy mission, but we’re more than ready to rise to that challenge. We all do it every day; navigating new, unexpected and sometimes even daunting challenges. But we believe in ourselves and trust we can do it. Want to innovate? Go for it. Push for a better way? You Can. If you think you have it in you, this is Where You Can.

The role:

Reporting to our Head of Reward, as the People Analytics Analyst you will help the People Team make informed, evidence-led decisions by turning data into clear, accurate and actionable insight.

Working across the People Team you will deliver reporting and analysis that supports organisational effectiveness, particularly focusing on Reward and People Operations among the wider team.

You will strengthen data quality, reporting controls and analytical capability across the People function, making insight easier to understand and use while protecting the confidentiality of employee information.

Key Responsibilities

  • Produce regular and ad hoc people reporting that gives stakeholders a clear view of workforce trends, risks and opportunities.

  • Analyse data across the employee lifecycle, including workforce composition, recruitment, retention, progression, performance, absence, engagement and inclusion.

  • Develop accessible dashboards, reports and visualisations that turn complex data into clear insights for People and business stakeholders.

  • Partner with Reward to support pay benchmarking, reward reviews, pay-positioning analysis and other compensation-related activity through accurate data preparation and analysis.

  • Maintain accurate and consistent people datasets, including clear data definitions, validation checks, reconciliation, documentation and version control.

  • Investigate data anomalies and work with People, Finance, Payroll and other stakeholders to resolve root causes and improve source-data quality.

  • Support workforce planning and organisational analysis by identifying patterns, modelling scenarios and presenting evidence-based observations.

  • Provide analytical support for People projects and recurring processes, ensuring outputs are accurate, timely and appropriate for their intended audience.

  • Improve reporting processes through automation, standardisation and the reduction of unnecessary manual activity.

  • Promote responsible use of people data by applying appropriate confidentiality, access, governance and quality controls.

What success looks like in the role:

  • Stakeholders receive accurate, timely and decision-ready people insights that help them understand workforce priorities and take appropriate action.

  • Core People reporting is supported by clear definitions, effective controls and reliable data that stakeholders trust.

  • People analytics increasingly covers the wider employee lifecycle, while Reward receives consistent and high-quality analytical support.

  • Recurring reports and processes become more efficient, scalable and easier to use through thoughtful automation and standardisation.

  • Complex findings are communicated clearly, with appropriate context, enabling stakeholders to understand both the evidence and its limitations.

Skills & Experience:

  • Experience in people analytics, HR reporting, workforce analytics, business analysis or another data-focused role.

  • Strong analytical and numerical skills, including experience working with detailed or complex datasets.

  • Ability to translate analysis into concise insights, clear visual outputs and practical recommendations.

  • Strong Excel capability, including formulas, data validation, reconciliation, data manipulation and structured analysis. Use or advocacy of AI is welcome.

  • Experience producing recurring reports, dashboards or management information for different stakeholder groups.

  • Strong attention to detail and a consistent approach to checking, documenting and controlling analytical outputs.

  • Understanding of data quality, confidentiality and the responsible handling of sensitive employee information.

  • Ability to investigate anomalies, identify root causes and work collaboratively with others to resolve data issues.

  • Strong planning and organisational skills, with the ability to manage recurring reporting alongside ad hoc analytical requests.

  • Clear communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to explain analytical findings to non-technical audiences.

Nice-to-have

  • Experience working within a People or HR function in a regulated organisation, financial-services business or technology company.

  • Familiarity with HR information systems, reporting platforms or data-visualisation tools.

  • Experience supporting workforce planning, organisational design, employee-listening or inclusion analysis.

  • Exposure to reward analytics, salary benchmarking, pay-review modelling or compensation data.

  • Experience improving or automating reporting and data processes.

Ways of Working & Culture

  • Care like we mean it: Handle people data with care, respect and discretion, while producing insight that considers its impact on colleagues and the organisation.

  • Build trust together: Take ownership of data quality and delivery, follow through on commitments, exercise sound judgement and raise risks or limitations early.

  • Grow with the challenge: Stay curious, seek feedback and build analytical capability while adapting to changing priorities and new questions.

  • Succeed as one: Work collaboratively across People, Reward, Finance, Payroll and the wider business, engaging stakeholders early and focusing on shared outcomes.

  • Clear a bold new path: Challenge inefficient reporting practices, test better approaches and build solutions that can scale as the organisation’s analytical needs evolve.

Role Level: 2

If this sounds like you then we encourage you to dust off that CV and apply!

*Please note that we are not currently able to sponsor applicants for immigration purposes.

A little bit more about us! 

ClearBank is Where You Can belong: 

At ClearBank we think about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) a lot. Not because we think we should. But because we know we should – how else can we build a happy workforce and be successful as a business. We’re committed to making sure our teams reflect society. And we put energy and effort into making this a place where everyone feels at home, where they’re given the trust and encouragement to do their very best work. Here are some of the things we’re most proud of: 

  • 42% of our senior management roles are held by women 

  • Our enhanced family leave policies

  • Launching our partnership with Code First Girls 

  • Increasing awareness of neurodiversity in the workplace through our partnership with the Inclusive Group 

Our hiring process and what you can expect:

Application: a member of our talent acquisition team will review your application against the key requirements for the role and let you know within two weeks whether you’re moving forward to the next stage; 

Screening: You’ll spend 30-45 minutes speaking to one of our recruiters learning more about the role and ClearBank, and we’ll get it know more about you, your experience and how your skills align with the role (this will be via phone or Teams video call). You can expect to hear back from us within seven days following this meeting (if things are taking longer than expected, we’ll let you know that too); 

First Interview: You’ll spend one hour with a member of our hiring team focusing on your skills, competencies and your ways of working at the same time we’ll give you time to ask more questions about the role, the team and learn more about the ClearBank culture. This will be via Teams.  

Second Interview: This will be a competency-based interview with one or more members of our team.

Final Stage: You will have a final meeting with the Head of Department. This will be around 45-60 minutes.  

Offer: Congratulations! Get ready to transform banking forever!

_________________________________________________
Director of Communications – International Shows (Touring & Resident)
Sales, Marketing and Communications
Full-Time Position


Reports to: Reports to Vice President - Commercial, Europe, Middle East and Asia with a functional reporting line to SVP, Communication

Scope: All international shows outside the Americas (Europe, UK, Middle East, Africa, Asia-Pacific & Oceania) + Public Affairs
 
Teams: Touring show PR teams (embedded on tour) + Resident show PR teams, and their respective agency rosters
 
 
Role Purpose
 
The Director of Communications – International Shows (Touring & Resident) is responsible for driving demand, building anticipation, and ensuring cultural relevance for Cirque du Soleil’s shows across all markets outside the Americas.
 
This role elevates show communications into a strategic growth engine, integrating PR, earned media, and public affairs to create urgency, unlock market opportunities, and support commercial performance across every international production.
 
Based in London, this role acts as the central show communications and public affairs lead for international markets, ensuring alignment between show storytelling, market-level marketing plans, and cross-functional execution across multiple time zones, languages, and regulatory environments.
 
 
Core Mission
  • Drive anticipation, urgency, and sustained demand for international touring and resident shows
  • Make communications a core lever of the show marketing mix, fully integrated with paid, CRM, and ticketing
  • Lead, develop, and set standards for the touring and resident show PR teams and the agencies that support them
  • Own the strategy and governance of show-specific social media channels as an earned and owned demand driver
  • Leverage public affairs as a growth enabler to unlock market access, market entry, and partnerships
  • Ensure communications is a core driver of ticket revenue and brand equity outside the Americas
  • Orchestrate cross-functional alignment to deliver cohesive show launches across diverse international markets
Key Responsibilities
 
1. Show Communications Strategy – International Touring, Resident Shows & Public Affairs
  • Lead and oversee an international show communications strategy spanning touring productions, resident shows, and public affairs
  • Embed communications within the end-to-end demand engine (onsale → launch → sustain), in lockstep with market marketing plans
  • Integrate public affairs into market entry and growth strategies for new territories
  • Lead communications strategy in support of sponsorships and business development, including building relationships with key stakeholders, and developing joint communication plans with partners
2. Show Communications Leadership (Europe, UK, Middle East, Africa, APAC & Oceania)
  • Own communications strategy and performance across all international touring and resident productions
  • Ensure each show delivers:
    • Clear, differentiated narrative
    • Strong local and cultural relevance, adapted per market and language
    • Full lifecycle comms (pre-onsale → launch → sustain)
  • Implement standards, playbooks, and governance that scale across markets and local agency partners
  • Act as spokesperson for international shows and manage show-level issues in market, escalating to corporate communications at HQ where required
3. Show-Specific Social Media Ownership
  • Ensure each show PR team owns the strategy, management, and community engagement for its show-specific social media channels
  • Set the content, tone, and publishing standards that keep show channels distinctive while consistent with the masterbrand
  • Align show channel activity to the onsale, launch, and sustain calendar in each market
  • Drive creator, influencer, and talent-led content through show channels to build cultural relevance and organic reach
  • Set and track channel performance measures (growth, engagement, referral to ticketing) alongside earned media KPIs
  • Ensure coordination with central brand and social teams on shared assets, escalation paths, and community management protocols
4. Public Affairs & Stakeholder Engagement
  • Leverage public affairs as a strategic growth enabler by building relationships with:
    • Government and public sector stakeholders across international markets
    • Tourism boards, city partners, venues, and cultural institutions
  • Unlock opportunities to:
    • Support market entry for touring and resident shows
    • Facilitate partnerships and local integration
    • Strengthen Cirque du Soleil’s institutional influence outside the Americas
  • Coordinate closely with internal stakeholders to align on regulatory, reputational, and market access considerations, including visas, work permits, and cross-border touring requirements
5. Cross-Functional Orchestration
  • Own coordination across non-marketing functions to ensure aligned execution and messaging around shows, including:
    • Legal
    • HR (incl. talent mobility, immigration)
    • Sustainability
    • Operations
    • Sponsorship & partnerships
  • Act as the central orchestrator ensuring communications supports and amplifies show and market decisions
  • Ensure consistency between internal decisions, external messaging, and market execution, and act as the two-way bridge between international markets and HQ
6. Cultural Relevance & Media Impact
  • Position Cirque du Soleil’s shows as culturally relevant and premium in international markets
  • Build relationships with Tier 1 media, creators, and influencers across the UK, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific
  • Activate cultural moments and partnerships tied to international show launches and runs
7. Team Leadership, Agency Governance & Performance
  • Lead and develop the PR teams embedded with the touring shows and the PR teams responsible for the resident shows, across multiple markets, time zones, and languages
  • Build a consistent operating model, capability plan, and career path across both team groups, including onboarding for new tours and openings
  • Approve and sign off on all agency appointments, scopes, and budgets proposed by the touring and resident show PR teams
  • Define and manage the international agency ecosystem, setting selection criteria, performance standards, and review cadence
  • Set KPIs tied to business impact (demand, awareness, launch momentum, ticket sales, social channel performance)
  • Partner with marketing and analytics to link comms and social to revenue outcomes
Profile & Experience
 
Required
  • 10+ years in communications/PR with multi-market, international leadership experience
  • Proven ability to operate communications as a growth and demand lever tied to sales outcomes
  • Strong experience in consumer, brand, or entertainment PR, ideally with campaign or launch ownership
  • Experience working with government or public sector stakeholders in international markets
  • Deep media relationships across the UK and Europe, with demonstrated reach into additional international markets
  • Experience directly leading distributed, multi-time-zone in-house teams, including teams embedded with touring operations
  • Proven track record appointing, contracting, and managing PR agencies across multiple markets
  • Strong command of organic social media strategy and community management for consumer or entertainment brands
  • Ability to operate in a matrixed, cross-functional environment with a North America–based headquarters
  • Fluent in English (mandatory); willingness to travel frequently across international markets
Preferred
  • Additional language(s) relevant to key international markets (e.g. French, Spanish, German, Arabic, Japanese, Mandarin)
  • Experience in entertainment, touring productions, live events, or premium brands
  • Strong understanding of how communications integrates with marketing, CRM, and revenue generation

jobs.title: Chief Business Officer (gn) @ Clean Data Centres Venture, France (hybrid)
jobs.description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio company.

Why we exist

Every frontier model is now gated by two things: megawatts and cooling. Grid queues stretch for years, land is contested, freshwater is political.

Far offshore, the wind blows stronger and steadier than anywhere on Earth, a vast resource the grid can, by definition, never reach.

So we flipped the problem. Instead of bringing power to the load, we bring the load to the power. Our autonomous wind-turbine energy ships chase the wind across the open ocean and convert it on board into what the world needs most: compute first, then e-fuels to decarbonise aviation.

  • 70%+ capacity factor — offshore wind that behaves like baseload

  • ~€50/MWh target cost for firm, low-carbon power

  • Zero grid queue. Zero freshwater. Zero land. And the ocean as the heat sink under every rack.

Founded in 2025 by repeat entrepreneurs (with successful exits) and industrial operators. Backed by major international investors. First demonstrator vessel at sea in late 2027.

The role

This is not a sales job. It's a late co-founder seat. You will own Offshore Compute, our first and main commercial engine: strategy, product, pricing, customers and the multi-million-dollar off-take deals that put our first fleet to work.

You already know that power and thermal limits are what will stall AI scaling. You're bold enough to believe infrastructure at sea can get around both, and rigorous enough to prove it to a sceptical buyer.

What you'll do

  • Write the go-to-market from a blank page. Build the global commercial roadmap, from first demonstrator workloads to full fleet monetisation.

  • Land the anchor deals. Negotiate and close off-take agreements, capacity reservations and JVs with neoclouds, AI labs, CSPs and Tier-1 HPC operators.

  • Turn variable power into a feature. Design offers built for wind-backed power profiles: fault-tolerant batch training, asynchronous inference, dynamic pricing, zero-carbon AI clouds.

  • Connect the C-suite to the hull. Translate client requirements (SLA, latency, direct-to-chip liquid cooling) into onboard architecture specs together with our marine engineers.

  • Create a category. Use our advantages — no grid wait, no freshwater, a direct ocean cooling sink, very low carbon intensity — to win premium pricing and long-term commitments, and establish floating compute as a new asset class.

  • Be the face of it. Represent us at the top AI, cloud and infrastructure summits worldwide and make us the reference for next-generation AI energy infrastructure.

You might be the one if

  • You've been in the room where AI capacity gets bought. You've sold, built or run serious infrastructure in the neocloud, AI infra, CSP or hyperscale data center world, and you've closed the kind of deals that move megawatts. We care about what you've shipped, not what your business card said.

  • You know GPU economics inside out. H100 / B200 / GB200 cluster economics, orchestration, workload constraints. And you know the people across the neocloud and AI ecosystem who sign capacity deals.

  • You speak the physics. MW-scale power delivery, PUE, direct-to-chip liquid cooling, thermal budgets. You can explain in one slide why land-based data centers are hitting the grid wall.

  • You've built something from zero. You've scaled a business line, closed complex multi-million infrastructure contracts and thrived with high autonomy and high ambiguity.

  • The ocean pulls at you. You care about climate, and standing on the deck of a floating compute lab during sea trials sounds like the best day of your year.

  • You work in English. Fluent English is required. French is a bonus.

How you operate

  • Owner, not operator. You don't wait for a playbook. You write it.

  • Maths over rhetoric. When a buyer is sceptical about offshore compute, you open the energy and thermal maths.

  • Realistic madness. You have the conviction to break paradigms and the engineering and commercial discipline to deliver.

  • Humble and brave. You stay intellectually humble and still take bold positions, especially where conventional playbooks fail.

  • AI-native. You use modern AI tools for maximum leverage while keeping the domain authority to negotiate directly with C-level executives.

What's in it for you

  • A founding-team seat with executive terms, shaping the company and not just a function

  • A real shot at creating a new asset class at the intersection of AI, energy and the ocean

  • A small, uncompromising team of entrepreneurs and industrial leaders, backed by top-tier capital

  • Flexible hours, a base in Nantes and a mandate that spans the globe

At Allucent™, we are dedicated to helping small-medium biopharmaceutical companies efficiently navigate the complex world of clinical trials to bring life-changing therapies to patients in need across the globe. At Allucent we are big enough to deliver and small enough to care. We know all our colleagues by name and work together as a team to make everyone SHINE.

The role

As a Contractor CRA, you will take the lead on monitoring activities, owning your sites and relationships with investigators. You’ll be the bridge between sponsor and site, ensuring trial integrity while being supported by a collaborative, experienced team. This includes work related to regulatory affairs, site activation processes—including contracting and start-up activities—to ensure smooth and compliant study execution. Main responsibilities:

  • Independently manage all aspects of monitoring for assigned clinical trials across study phases, including site initiation, routine monitoring, and close-out visits.
  • Ensure compliance with protocols, GCP, ICH, SOPs, and applicable regulatory requirements.

Requirements

You’re an experienced CRA ready to take the next step with a company that truly values your expertise and independence. You thrive in an agile, collaborative environment and want to be part of a team making a real impact.

  • Experience leading monitoring activities in complex trials, ideally in oncology or rare disease with a minimum of at least 5 years’ experience.
  • Strong understanding of ICH-GCP and regulatory guidelines.
  • Clear and confident communicator in English and Hebrew.
  • Comfortable working independently and managing priorities.
  • Willingness to travel, as required.

About Allucent

At Allucent, our mission is to shine a light on new therapies that improve lives. When you join our team, you’ll use your unique skills, expertise, and knowledge to forge meaningful partnerships with clients while helping them turn groundbreaking ideas into life-changing treatments.

 

If you’re passionate about advancing pharmaceuticals and biologics, fueled by an entrepreneurial spirit, and eager to collaborate with top minds across science, business, and operations, we’d love to connect. jobs.title: Propulsion Data & Modeling Engineer
jobs.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation.

The heart of a spacecraft lies in its propulsion system, and that's why we, at The Exploration Company, are dedicated to developing our own cutting-edge Propulsion Systems ensuring the highest level of efficiency and reliability in our space endeavours.

We want you as a talented Propulsion Functional Systems Engineer to contribute to the development, testing, analysis, prediction and refinement of the functional architecture for Nyx Earth Propulsion System Development Models.

In order to derisk and gain confidence on the flight propulsion system, different development models are being built in order to run a multitude of tests spanning from functional tests, cold flows to system level hot fires. This testing will allow for the verification and validation of all the propulsion subsystems. You will be responsible for bridging the gap between design and hardware testing for the Nyx spacecraft propulsion system. As such, you will work closely with both the design and testing teams to ensure seamless integration and validation of propulsion subsystems.

You will report to the Propulsion Development Models Principal Engineer.

Key responsibilities:

In your capacity as a Propulsion Functional Systems Engineer, you will be responsible for the development of analysis, post processing, and prediction tools that can support testing and design activities linked to the propulsion sub-systems.

Your role will be continuously evolving, but day-to-day responsibilities will include:

During the Design Phase:

  • Work closely with the pressure and feed system engineers to define the best configuration of the test setups, ensuring a high level of representativeness and testability to conduct all fluid modelling and analyses to verify repeatability of the test rigs with the flight systems and to perform test predictions.

  • Support on the creation of test plans for propulsion subsystems (from a modeling perspective), including data acquisition, analysis, and reporting to ensure the performance of the system can be assessed.

  • Design and develop propulsion analysis and post processing tools, to support testing activities and design maturation

  • Work in close collaboration with the pressure and feed system engineers to ensure the anchoring of the different fluidic models and assess against test data

During testing phase:

  • Provide on-site support during propulsion test campaigns, working closely with the test operator and test conductor.

  • Perform test campaigns, analysing in real-time, through different test parameters and ensure test results with timely resolution of any anomaly arising during testing.

  • Conduct pre-test and post-test reviews and elaborate the test reports.

  • Update and correlate the fluidic models based on test results.

  • Provide actionable insights to identify key performance indicators and potential critical scenarios

What we would love to see from you:

  • A minimum of a bachelor's degree in a related Engineering discipline.

  • +3 years of related experience in complex fluid systems, fluidic modeling, data analysis and data post processing.

  • Strong engineering fundamentals in thermodynamics, fluid dynamics, and combustion principles.

  • Familiarity with test facilities, or storable propulsion systems is an asset

  • Experience in propulsion systems storable or cryogenic fluidic systems is a plus.

  • Proficiency in python for fluid analyses, data post processing and model anchoring.

  • Experience in EcosimPro (or similar software) for the high fidelity analysis of numerical twins.

  • Proficiency in conducting fluid analyses using classical hand calculations

  • Excellent collaboration skills for working effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

  • Fluency in English.

Skills and Behaviours:

  • Strong oral and written communication skills.

  • Strong analysis and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong organizing and prioritization of tasks.

  • Strong team player with a proactive mindset.

  • Positive and flexible attitude to get the job done.

  • Ability to communicate at all levels of the business.

  • Demonstrates behaviours consistent with The Exploration Company’s core values of Mission, Vision, Integrity, Excellence and Teamwork.

  • Space enthusiast, ready to change the European space industry.

  • Nice to have, Ecosim experience

jobs.description:
IMT Atlantique, reconnue internationalement pour la qualité de sa recherche, est une école d’ingénieurs de premier plan sous la tutelle du ministère de l'industrie et du numérique, classée dans les trois principaux classements internationaux (THE, SHANGHAI, QS).

 

Le poste est ouvert sur le campus de Rennes au sein du département SRCD (Systèmes Réseaux, Cybersécurité et Droit du numérique). Le département SRCD est composé de 24 enseignant.e.s-chercheurs.euses permanent.e.s, plus de 10 post-doctorant.e.s et ingénieur.e.s contractuel.le.s, et 30 doctorant.e.s. Ses domaines d'activité recouvrent tous les aspects de l'enseignement et de la recherche en systèmes et réseaux au sens large, en cybersécurité, et en droit et économie des activités numériques. Dans le cadre de ses activités de recherche, la personne recrutée rejoindra l’équipe SOTERN (Self Protecting the Future Internet) du département D2 du laboratoire IRISA (UMR CNRS 6074), l'un des plus grands laboratoires de recherche français (+ de 850 personnes) dans le domaine de l'informatique et des nouvelles technologies de l'information.

Enjeux et profil attendu sur le thématique de recherche

 

Deux enjeux majeurs présentent actuellement un impact conséquent sur la recherche et l’innovation en Cybersécurité. D’un côté, l’intelligence artificielle par ses développements récents et les attendus pour les années à venir décuple les possibilités offertes aux attaquants pour mettre en œuvre de nouvelles attaques, tout autant qu’aux structures défensives (type SOC par exemple) pour détecter, corréler et contrer des incidents de sécurité. D’un autre côté, les cibles des attaques évoluent et les architectures déployées dans les réseaux opérationnels (systèmes industriels, réseaux intra-véhiculaires, avionique, opérateurs d’importance vitale) nécessitent de nouveaux moyens de détection et protection face à une menace grandissante.

Le profil recherché pour ce poste s’inscrit ainsi dans la thématique de la sécurité des réseaux au sens large. Il sera plus spécifiquement recherché soit une expertise relative aux architectures, protocoles et algorithmes d’intelligence artificielle pour la sécurité des réseaux ou de l’IA (apprentissage fédéré, sécurité des architectures d’IA type Model Context Protocol (MCP), etc.), soit une expertise sur la sécurité des réseaux opérationnels (OT) quel qu’en soit le cadre applicatif.  

 

Enjeux et profil attendu en enseignement

 

Positionnée sur 3 campus attractifs, IMT Atlantique affiche une forte dynamique internationale tout en restant à taille humaine. Dans ces différents cursus BAC+5 (formations d’ingénieurs et de masters-DNM), les étudiants sont confrontés, via des approches pédagogiques variées, à des situations-problèmes concrets. L’école a ainsi pour ambition de former de jeunes professionnels à fort potentiel, capables de mobiliser un large spectre de compétences en situation réelle, dans des environnements (production, recherche, création d’activité, etc.) et des domaines socio-économiques variés.

 

Impliqué tant en tronc commun que dans les parcours électifs, la personne recrutée contribuera aussi bien dans sa spécialité Cybersécurité que dans des activités transverses, interdisciplinaires ou en lien avec des entreprises : tutorat de projets / stages, soutenances, accompagnement, etc. La personne recrutée sera encouragée à contribuer, dans un esprit de collaboration, à l’évolution cohérente des programmes d’études, en proposant de nouveaux projets, programmes et méthodologies pédagogiques, particulièrement inspirés et soutenus par les exigences et les partenariats industriels. https://www.imt-atlantique.fr/fr/formation

 

En cohérence avec le profil de la personne candidate, il sera demandé de prendre en main les thématiques d’enseignement parmi les suivantes : IA et Cybersécurité (IA offensive, IA pour la protection des infrastructures, sécurité de l’IA), Sécurité des systèmes industriels, participation puis prise de responsabilité de l’organisation du CTF Hack’lantique, et plus largement une participation aux différents enseignements en Cybersécurité.

tags: Matériaux à haute performance et éco-matériaux
jobs.description:
ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE :

École du ministère en charge de l’industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines-Télécom (IMT), 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l’avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses quatre missions : former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l’innovation, en un cercle vertueux et porteur d’innovation.

Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche place IMT Mines Albi comme une école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT : l’industrie du futur responsable ; l’énergie, l’économie circulaire et la société ; l’ingénierie, la santé et le bien-être. IMT Mines Albi s’est dotée en 2023, pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en sept grandes actions, répondant aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT auquel elle appartient.

 

IMT Mines Albi représente :

  • 985 élèves-ingénieurs et chercheurs en formation ;

  • 300 personnels ;

  • un budget consolidé de 32 M€ ;

  • trois centres de formation et de recherche : Institut Clément Ader Albi (ICA-A), RAPSODEE et Centre Génie Industriel.

 

 

Le Centre Institut Clément Ader Albi (ICA-A) est un centre de formation et de recherche d’IMT Mines Albi. Il rassemble 70 personnes, dont 20 enseignants-chercheurs.

Au titre de la formation, il est un acteur de la formation ingénieur généraliste d’IMT Mines Albi, sous statut étudiant ou apprenti, et porte l’option « Matériaux et procédés avancés pour les transports de demain ».

 

Au titre de la recherche, il est partie intégrante de l’Institut Clément Ader (ICA – UMR CNRS 5312), laboratoire rassemblant 250 personnes et développant des thématiques scientifiques axées sur l’ingénierie et la mécanique des matériaux, notamment dans le domaine de l’aéronautique. Ses cinq établissements de tutelle sont l’INSA de Toulouse, l’ISAE-SUPAERO, l’Université Paul Sabatier, IMT Mines Albi et le CNRS.

 

Site Internet de l’ICA : https://ica.cnrs.fr/

 

L’ICA traite des études sur les structures, les systèmes et les processus mécaniques. Ses secteurs d’activité sont les industries mécaniques, avec un accent particulier sur l’aérospatiale, l’espace, le transport et l’énergie.

Le centre Institut Clément Ader Albi contribue aux quatre groupes de recherche de l’ICA :

  • Matériaux et Structures Composites ;

  • Surfaces, Usinage, Matériaux, Outillages ;

  • Métrologie, Identification, Contrôle, Surveillance ;

  • Modélisation des Systèmes et Microsystèmes Mécaniques.

 

Le champ d’action d’ICA-A est d’optimiser les outillages ou les procédés de mise en forme des matériaux (métaux, composites, polymères, verres, etc.) ainsi que d’étudier les relations entre microstructure, procédé et comportement, en particulier pour les secteurs de l’aéronautique et du spatial. Ses activités sont fortement expérimentales, mais également numériques.

 

ICA-A possède sa propre plateforme de recherche sur le campus d’IMT Mines Albi, la plateforme MIMAUSA. ICA-A est une Zone à Régime Restrictif (ZRR) depuis 2021.

 

DESCRIPTION DU POSTE :

De manière générale, la personne recrutée participera aux projets pédagogiques de l’école, aux missions de formation, aux activités de recherche et de transfert de technologies, au montage et au suivi des activités contractuelles ainsi qu’aux collaborations nationales et internationales. Elle contribuera activement au développement de ces activités et pourra être amenée à exercer des responsabilités administratives et d’encadrement.

 

La personne recrutée aura notamment vocation à assurer :

 

  • des responsabilités pédagogiques : responsable de cycle d’enseignement, responsable d’option, responsable de Master ou Mastère, responsable d’unité d’enseignement ;

  • et/ou des responsabilités en recherche : directeur de centre, directeur de centre adjoint, responsable de groupe de recherche, responsable d’axe de recherche, responsable de plateforme ;

  • et/ou des responsabilités liées au transfert industriel et au développement économique ;

  • et/ou des responsabilités transverses, comme par exemple : responsable de processus ou sous-processus, responsable thématique international.

 

Activités de formation

Dans le programme de formation du centre ICA-A, la personne recrutée participera aux activités pédagogiques et d’enseignement d’IMT Mines Albi.

 Dans ce cadre, elle sera amenée à :

  • contribuer à l’évolution des programmes pédagogiques et assurer des enseignements dans les domaines de l’analyse de données et de l’intelligence artificielle appliquées à l’écoconception, au développement de nouveaux matériaux, à leur mise en forme, ainsi qu’à l’étude de leurs mécanismes de dégradation et à la prévision de la durée de vie des pièces ;

  • accompagner et organiser les missions de formation de l’École sous leurs diverses formes : formation initiale ou continue, sous statut étudiant ou salarié, et formations débouchant sur des diplômes de Mastère ou de Master ;

  • participer au montage ou au pilotage de nouvelles formations (Mastère ou Master), prendre la responsabilité d’une ou plusieurs unités d’enseignement, s’impliquer dans l’organisation et le suivi de projets étudiants, ainsi que dans l’élaboration et l’exploitation de MOOC ;

  • encadrer des projets avec mises en situation, des stages et des travaux de fin d’études.

 

Activités de recherche

 Dans le programme de recherche du centre ICA-A, la personne recrutée :

  • proposera une démarche scientifique pour le développement de méthodes innovantes d’exploitation et d’analyse de données et d’utilisation de l’IA, capables de répondre aux exigences d’un dialogue essais/calcul multi-échelles. Ces méthodes seront utilisées pour le suivi ou la compréhension des propriétés des matériaux en lien avec leur fabrication ou avec le suivi de l’état de santé de pièces en service dans des environnements potentiellement critiques (hautes ou basses températures, contraintes mécaniques fortes, atmosphères oxydantes ou corrosives) ;

  • sera rattachée à un des groupes de recherche du laboratoire ICA (UMR 5312)

  • devra démontrer sa capacité à développer une activité contractuelle avec les entreprises et à participer au montage de chaires d’enseignement et de recherche en relation avec les entreprises ;

  • contribuera au rayonnement scientifique d’IMT Mines Albi et du laboratoire ICA par une implication active dans l’encadrement de thèses et de post-doctorants, par une production scientifique significative, par la diffusion de l’information scientifique lors de conférences et par l’organisation de manifestations scientifiques ;

  • sera amenée à monter des projets collaboratifs en lien avec les autres centres de recherche d’IMT Mines Albi : RAPSODEE et CGI.

 

 

Activités de valorisation et de développement économique

Dans le programme de valorisation et de développement économique du centre ICA-A, la personne recrutée devra :

  • renforcer le développement économique local et régional par l’accompagnement d’entités en incubation ou en prospection d’incubation au sein d’IMT Mines Albi ;

  • et/ou soutenir les initiatives ponctuelles en répondant aux demandes d’accompagnement (thèses CIFRE, contrats directs) formulées par les entreprises, en particulier les TPE et PME, dans son domaine d’expertise ;

  • et/ou accompagner la dynamique industrielle en s’impliquant dans la mise en place et le pilotage de chaires industrielles ou de laboratoires communs permettant d’optimiser le transfert technologique et méthodologique à destination des acteurs locaux, régionaux ou nationaux.

 

Évolution des responsabilités

À moyen terme, la personne recrutée pourra se voir proposer :

  • des responsabilités pédagogiques : responsable de cycle d’enseignement, responsable d’option, responsable de Master ou Mastère, responsable d’unité d’enseignement ;

  • et/ou des responsabilités en recherche : responsable de groupe de recherche, responsable d’axe de recherche, responsable de plateforme ;

  • et/ou des responsabilités liées au transfert industriel et au développement économique.

 

 

PROFIL RECHERCHE :

La personne candidate devra justifier d’une expérience d’au moins huit ans en recherche dans la spécialité Data/IA appliquée aux matériaux et procédés.

 

Une qualification aux fonctions de professeur en 60e section du CNU est fortement souhaitée.

 

En outre, la personne candidate devra :

 

  • présenter une expertise scientifique dans plusieurs des domaines suivants : jumeaux numériques, dynamique des systèmes, machine learning, deep learning, réseaux de neurones, deep optimisation ;

  • justifier d’expériences dans la conception et le pilotage de programmes pédagogiques ;

  • faire preuve d’une forte capacité et d’un goût prononcé pour l’animation d’une équipe de recherche ;

  • posséder de réelles qualités relationnelles, ainsi qu’un sens développé des relations humaines et des valeurs collectives ;

  • présenter une production scientifique cohérente avec les standards nationaux et internationaux et une expérience significative de l’encadrement doctoral.

 

AU-DELÀ DE L’ENVIRONNEMENT PROFESSIONNEL, POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ? 

  • Un cadre de travail agréable sur un campus de 22 hectares ;

  • un forfait cadre avec 49 jours de congés annuels (congés + RTT) ;

  • le télétravail possible ;

  • une restauration administrative sur place ;

  • une aide à la mobilité durable pour les trajets domicile-travail ;

  • une action sociale (protection sociale complémentaire et aide aux familles) ;

  • une aide au déménagement ;

  • une aide à l’intégration sur le territoire : https://www.grand-albigeois.fr/entreprendre/creer-se-developper/soutien-au-recrutement-salarie/

 

INFORMATIONS COMPLÉMENTAIRES :

  • Statut : fonctionnaire ou détachement sur notre cadre de gestion.

  • À usage interne :

• Catégorie du poste et métier de référence : métier A – Professeur, Directeur d’études et Directeur de recherches

• Métier(s) de référence des agents pouvant postuler : toutes catégories

 

  • Localisation : Albi – IMT Mines Albi.

 

  • Date d’ouverture des candidatures : 1er octobre 2026.

  • Date limite de candidature : 1er novembre 2026.

  • Date de prise de fonction souhaitée : 1er janvier 2027.

 

Les postes offerts au recrutement sont ouverts à toutes et tous avec, sur demande, des aménagements pour les candidates et candidats en situation de handicap.

 

Contacts :

Sur le contenu du poste :
Mme Anaïs BARASINSKI – Directrice de Centre
 

Sur les aspects administratifs/RH :
Mme Marie GILLET – Responsable Recrutement et Développement des Compétences
 

Protection des données

Dans le cadre du règlement général sur la protection des données, les candidates et candidats sont informés que les données les concernant seront conservées par l’administration pendant une durée maximale de deux ans, sauf demande contraire de leur part précisée dans la lettre de motivation.

jobs.title: STAGE - Junior Fullstack Engineer
jobs.description:
Notre mission ⚖️

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.


Contexte du stage

Depuis des années, Doctrine propose une fonctionnalité d’envoi de décision de justice en France à ses clients. Cela est une source précieuse de décisions de justice qui permet à Doctrine d’enrichir sa base de données (c'est-à-dire son legal graph) avec des décisions qui n’ont pas pu être ajoutées par nos processus habituels.

Le but de ce stage est l’internationalisation de cette fonctionnalité de manière à ce qu’elle soit utilisable dans tous les autres pays où Doctrine est actif (Italie, Allemagne).

Les tâches principales seront :
  • Le développement d’une application minimale pour la revue et validation des décisions de justice mises en ligne par nos utilisateurs pour nos juristes avant leur publication.
  • La migration du processus legacy d’upload français actuel pour se conformer au processus commun (internationalisé).
Une fois que le processus de mise en ligne de décisions par nos utilisateurs sera internationalisé, le ou la stagiaire pourra travailler sur des tâches d’amélioration de l’application de revue de décisions dans le but d’aider notre équipe de juristes à mieux traiter le volume de décisions mises en ligne.

Exemples de pistes d’amélioration (non exhaustif)
  • Application de techniques d’OCR sur les documents pour faciliter leur validation.
  • Détection via LLM d’attributs des décisions (niveau de confidentialité, juridiction, domaine du droit, cour, …) pour faciliter leur validation.
  • Aide au retrait de contenu qui n’est pas le texte de la décision (pages blanches, notification à l’avocat, …).
    Le ou la stagiaire devra participer à la définition de la solution et sa réalisation. Il ou elle rejoindra l’équipe Italie et sera amené·e à travailler avec les équipes des autres pays (principalement l’équipe France) et l’équipe légale. Il ou elle participera aussi au chapter web (regroupement de tous les développeurs full stack de l’entreprise).
 

Les à-côtés du poste 👁️
Le ou la stagiaire participera comme tous les ingénieurs à son chapter (réuni 2 fois par mois) dont le but est de :
  • Partager des connaissances entre ses membres (amélioration continue, bonnes pratiques)
  • Proposer des améliorations (nouveaux outils et processus)
  • Aider ses membres en fonction de leurs besoins

    • Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝

    • Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert.
    • Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides.
    • Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien.
    • Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc.

    Nos valeurs 🤝

    Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses.

    • Challenge the status quo : nous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur.
    • Liberty and responsibility : nous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership.
    • Knowledge is power : l'information est au cœur de la mission de Doctrine, et nous cherchons constamment à progresser.
    • Release early, release often and listen to your customers : nous croyons au pouvoir de l’itération et à l’importance d’écouter en permanence notre marché, nos client·e·s et leurs problématiques.
     

    Nos avantages pour faire la différence ☀️

    🏡 Une politique de télétravail flexible permettant - selon les équipes - jusqu’à trois jours de télétravail par semaine.

    🌴 Une politique de congés flexibles

    🌱 Des opportunités concrètes de mobilité interne

    🏄‍♂️ Des évènements collectifs réguliers

    📚 Un vrai accent sur la formation individuelle et collective, avec un budget annuel de 750€ pour toute formation en lien avec ton poste - et des formations en équipe ou pour toute l'entreprise

    🏋️‍♀️ Un abonnement Gymlib pour les activités sportives et bien-être

    🧘 Un accès gratuit à la plateforme d'accompagnement à la santé mentale Moka.care et un accompagnement individuel allant jusqu’à 6 séances par an

    👩‍⚕️ Une assurance santé avec Alan

    🍱 🚲 Une carte Swile pour tes tickets restaurants et ton forfait mobilité durable (66,60 euros par mois)

    💡 Des réductions et avantages négociés grâce à notre CSE via la plateforme Happypal

    🍏 Un équipement de travail neuf chez Apple

     

    Notre processus de recrutement 🚀

    • Un premier échange de 30 min avec l’un.e de nos Talent Acquisition Manager pour bien comprendre ton projet professionnel et te présenter ce qu'on construit chez Doctrine
    • Une rencontre d’1h avec ton/ta futur.e manager, pour détailler le poste et le scope de l’équipe, mais aussi répondre à toutes tes questions.
    • Un ou deux tests techniques pour évaluer concrètement tes compétences
    • Une venue dans nos bureaux pour : un déjeuner avec 3 personnes de différents départements chez Doctrine, pour te donner un aperçu de tes futur.e.s collègues ; un échange sur les valeurs de l’entreprise pour te partager notre vision, et une rencontre avec notre CEO, Guillaume.
    (si nécessaire le processus pourra être adapté pour répondre à tes contraintes personnelles et professionnelles)
     
     
    Mesdames, autorisez-vous à candidater !
    Certaines études scientifiques montrent qu'en particulier les femmes ont moins tendance à postuler à une offre d'emploi quand elles n'ont pas toutes les qualifications. Si cela peut vous rassurer, sachez que cette fiche de poste est indicative donc prenez la comme telle : c'est un guide, ni plus ni moins.
    Si Doctrine vous intéresse, sachez que nous aurons plaisir à recevoir votre candidature !
     
    Diversité & inclusion
    Toutes nos offres sont ouvertes aux personnes en situation de handicap, n'hésitez pas a nous en parler lors du process de recrutement.
    Nous nous engageons à mettre en place tous les aménagements nécessaires pour garantir un environnement de travail adapté a chacun et chacune

jobs.title: AI Research Engineer (Kernel & Inference Optimization)
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Research Engineer (Kernel & Inference Optimization) based in Switzerland.

You will work at the intersection of AI research, systems engineering, and high-performance model inference.
Your focus will be on developing and optimizing model-serving architectures for advanced AI systems across a range of hardware environments.
You will tackle challenges involving latency, throughput, memory efficiency, and scalability, including deployment on resource-constrained mobile and edge devices.
The role combines hands-on research with low-level engineering, giving you the opportunity to develop novel inference strategies and GPU kernels.
You will work with complex architectures spanning text, image, audio, diffusion models, and vision transformers.
Your work will involve rigorous benchmarking, production testing, and iterative optimization to translate research into measurable performance improvements.
You will collaborate with cross-functional teams in a highly technical, remote environment focused on pushing the boundaries of efficient AI systems.


Accountabilities
  • Design and deploy advanced model-serving architectures optimized for high throughput, low latency, and efficient memory utilization.
  • Develop inference pipelines capable of operating effectively across diverse environments, including resource-constrained mobile devices and edge platforms.
  • Establish clear performance targets covering response latency, token generation speed, throughput, memory footprint, and reliability.
  • Build and execute controlled inference benchmarks in simulated and production environments, tracking latency, throughput, memory consumption, and error rates.
  • Create and maintain representative datasets and simulation scenarios for evaluating model performance under real-world and resource-constrained conditions.
  • Identify computational and memory bottlenecks across inference pipelines and implement solutions involving batching, networking, memory management, and other system-level optimizations.
  • Develop custom GPU kernels and compute shaders for mobile hardware, including solutions written in Metal Shading Language (MSL).
  • Apply advanced inference optimization techniques such as pruning, quantization, Flash Attention, KV caching, and speculative decoding.
  • Design and optimize distributed inference systems using approaches such as tensor parallelism, pipeline parallelism, and expert parallelism for large-scale GPU workloads.
  • Work with cross-functional engineering and research teams to integrate optimized inference frameworks into production and edge-device applications.
  • Define evaluation methodologies, document experimental results, compare performance against established benchmarks, and continuously refine optimization strategies.
  • Monitor production performance and use empirical research to identify opportunities for further improvements in scalability, efficiency, and reliability.

    • Requirements:

    • Degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; a PhD in NLP, Machine Learning, or a related discipline is highly relevant, particularly with a strong AI research track record and publications at leading conferences.
    • Proven expertise in Metal Shading Language (MSL), including the ability to write custom compute shaders from scratch.
    • Demonstrated experience with low-level kernel optimization and inference optimization on mobile or other resource-constrained devices.
    • Track record of delivering measurable improvements in inference latency, throughput, and memory footprint for domain-specific applications.
    • Deep understanding of modern model-serving architectures, inference engines, and optimization techniques for high-performance AI deployment.
    • Strong experience writing GPU kernels for mobile devices such as smartphones.
    • Practical experience developing and deploying end-to-end inference pipelines, from model optimization through production integration on constrained hardware.
    • Strong ability to apply empirical research and systematic experimentation to solve latency, computational, and memory challenges.
    • Experience designing robust evaluation and benchmarking frameworks for inference systems.
